# file opened: zpolice.asm
   1  0000              ;==============================================================================
   2  0000              ; Z-POLICE  -  3D vector city flight for the ZX Spectrum Next
   3  0000              ;
   4  0000              ;  Z80N assembler (sjasmplus --zxnext).  Layer 2 256x192x8bpp, double buffered.
   5  0000              ;  The 3D viewport is the top 256x128; the bottom third is an instrument panel.
   6  0000              ;  Maths: world positions are 16-bit integers (one city cell = 256 units),
   7  0000              ;         trig values are S7.8 fixed point (1.0 = $0100).
   8  0000              ;  Hidden line removal: painter's algorithm. Buildings are walked over the
   9  0000              ;  grid far-to-near (no sort needed). Each visible face is filled in its
  10  0000              ;  shade (roof lighter, side turned away darker) and optionally outlined, so
  11  0000              ;  nearer buildings overwrite those behind them. Faces with every corner on
  12  0000              ;  screen use cached projections; faces crossing the view frustum are
  13  0000              ;  clipped in 3D (Sutherland-Hodgman, 5 planes). Rasterisation then only
  14  0000              ;  ever sees on-screen 8-bit coordinates.
  15  0000              ;
  16  0000              ;  Controls: Q/A speed up/down   Z air brake O/P turn left/right
  17  0000              ;            W/S climb/descend   E/D nose up/down
  18  0000              ;            SPACE fire          1-5 select weapon slot
  19  0000              ;            0 change the centre slot's weapon
  20  0000              ;
  21  0000              ;  Source files: zpolice.asm (resident main code), memory_bank_defs.asm
  22  0000              ;  (slots and pages).  Game logic pages, swapped into slot 6 at $C000:
  23  0000              ;  player.asm (input/movement), weapons.asm, menu.asm (main menu).  Core
  24  0000              ;  function pages, swapped into slot 7 at $E000: city.asm (Layer 2
  25  0000              ;  drawing), hud.asm (ULA HUD), input.asm (redefinable keys, joysticks), sprites.asm
  26  0000              ;  (hardware sprites).  Always mapped: zombie.asm at $2000, human.asm and
  27  0000              ;  map.asm (the city map) at $7000.
  28  0000              ;
  29  0000              ;  Memory while running:
  30  0000              ;    $0000-$1FFF  Layer 2 back buffer, one 8K section at a time (slot 0)
  31  0000              ;    $2000-$3FFF  zombie page (slot 1)
  32  0000              ;    $4000-$7FFF  occlusion data; cell colours, humans, map (slots 2-3)
  33  0000              ;    $8000-$9FFF  ULA screen (slot 4)
  34  0000              ;    $A000-$BFFF  resident code, tables, variables, stack (slot 5)
  35  0000              ;    $C000-$DFFF  game logic page (slot 6)
  36  0000              ;    $E000-$FFFF  core function page (slot 7)
  37  0000              ;==============================================================================
  38  0000
  39  0000                      DEVICE ZXSPECTRUMNEXT
  40  0000                      SLDOPT COMMENT WPMEM, LOGPOINT, ASSERTION
  41  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
  42  0000 ~                    CSPECTMAP "release_tmp/zpolice.map"
  43  0000                  ELSE
  44  0000                      CSPECTMAP zpolice.map
  45  0000                  ENDIF
  46  0000                      OPT --zxnext=cspect --syntax=a --reversepop
  47  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48  0000              ; Build options
  49  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  50  0000              ; RELEASE: the build for players (-DRELEASE: build.bat release).  Turns off
  51  0000              ; everything for testing, whatever is set below: the DEBUG_ settings, DRAW_FPS
  52  0000              ; and DOTS_ALL, a START_LEVEL_SET, a START_SALVAGE.  It's assembled into
  53  0000              ; release_tmp/, so the debug build's files (and the tests') stay as they are.
  54  0000
  55  0000              ; REAL_HARDWARE: the build for a real Next (-DREAL_HARDWARE: build.bat
  56  0000              ; hardware), which may use DMA+ (the zxnDDMA, the blitter of core 3.03.00, see
  57  0000              ; layer2_cls.asm).  Off, the DMA routines use only the plain zxnDMA, as CSpect
  58  0000              ; doesn't have DMA+ yet.  The .nex then also asks for core 3.03.00: on an older
  59  0000              ; core DMA+'s commands would be misread, not ignored.
  60  0000                      ;DEFINE REAL_HARDWARE
  61  0000                  IFDEF REAL_HARDWARE                 ; (said in the build's output)
  62  0000 ~                    DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE set: the build for a real Next (DMA+, core 3.03.00 or later)"
  63  0000                  ELSE
  64  0000                      DISPLAY "REAL_HARDWARE not set: the CSpect build (plain zxnDMA, no DMA+)"
  65  0000                  ENDIF
  66  0000
  67  0000              ; DRAW_LINES: outline building faces with EDGE_COL vectors.  Comment it out for solid-colour buildings only; the HUD
  68  0000              ; is always drawn.  Can also be set from the command line: -DDRAW_LINES
  69  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_LINES
  70  0000
  71  0000              ; WAIT_FOR_VBLANK: wait for the raster to leave the display area before
  72  0000              ; flipping the Layer 2 buffers (no tearing).  Comment it out to flip as soon
  73  0000              ; as a frame is drawn: faster, but the flip may tear mid-screen.
  74  0000              ; Command line: -DWAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  75  0000                      ;DEFINE WAIT_FOR_VBLANK
  76  0000
  77  0000              ; DRAW_FPS: measure frames per second from the raster (vtick) and show it at
  78  0000              ; the top left of the ULA screen.  Comment it out to drop the measuring and
  79  0000              ; the display.  Command line: -DDRAW_FPS
  80  0000                      ;DEFINE DRAW_FPS
  81  0000
  82  0000              ; SKY_IS_WALL: the camera can never rise above the perimeter wall, so fill
  83  0000              ; the sky in the wall's colour and draw wall cells only up to camera height
  84  0000              ; (their top edge is then exactly the horizon).  No sky is ever seen.
  85  0000              ; Command line: -DSKY_IS_WALL
  86  0000                      DEFINE SKY_IS_WALL
  87  0000
  88  0000              ; OCCLUSION_CULL: in level flight, record the buildings, then cull those
  89  0000              ; completely hidden behind nearer ones (a per-column cover buffer, front to
  90  0000              ; back) before drawing the rest.  Uses pages PAGE_OCC0/1 at $4000-$7FFF.
  91  0000              ; Command line: -DOCCLUSION_CULL
  92  0000                      DEFINE OCCLUSION_CULL
  93  0000
  94  0000              ; OCC_PITCHED: OCCLUSION_CULL pitched too, up to OCC_PMAX (18, city2.asm;
  95  0000              ; past it the plain way).  Pitched, occ_pretest has bounds of its own
  96  0000              ; (occ_pretest.pit), and a building covers only the columns of both its top
  97  0000              ; and bottom corners (its vertical edges lean).  Pixel-identical (124 random
  98  0000              ; pitched views; test_render.py checks 16 against the painter's path).
  99  0000              ; Comment it out for level flight only.  Command line: -DOCC_PITCHED
 100  0000                      DEFINE OCC_PITCHED
 101  0000
 102  0000              ; LEVEL_FAST_PATH: while pitch is 0 (level flight) a building's top corners
 103  0000              ; have the same camera X and Z as the bottom corners below them, so each top
 104  0000              ; corner reuses its bottom corner's screen x and 1/Z and only works out its
 105  0000              ; screen y.  Comment it out to project every corner in full.
 106  0000              ; Command line: -DLEVEL_FAST_PATH
 107  0000                      DEFINE LEVEL_FAST_PATH
 108  0000
 109  0000              ; CLIP_2D: a face that crosses only the screen's sides, top or bottom, and is
 110  0000              ; within a guard band (|X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z), has its corners projected to
 111  0000              ; 16-bit screen coordinates and is clipped against the screen in 2D, not in
 112  0000              ; 3D (no new points to project, one multiply per new point, not three).
 113  0000              ; Faces crossing the near plane, or outside the guard band, are clipped in
 114  0000              ; 3D as before.  Comment it out to clip every face in 3D.
 115  0000              ; Command line: -DCLIP_2D
 116  0000                      DEFINE CLIP_2D
 117  0000
 118  0000                  IFDEF RELEASE
 119  0000 ~                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
 120  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DRAW_FPS
 121  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 122  0000 ~                  IFDEF DOTS_ALL
 123  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE DOTS_ALL
 124  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 125  0000 ~                  IFDEF START_LEVEL_SET
 126  0000 ~                    UNDEFINE START_LEVEL_SET
 127  0000 ~                  ENDIF
 128  0000                  ENDIF

# file opened: memory_bank_defs.asm
   1+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ 0000              ; Z-POLICE - memory bank definitions
   3+ 0000              ;
   4+ 0000              ; The Next maps its RAM into the Z80's 64K as eight 8K MMU slots, each set by
   5+ 0000              ; a NextReg ($50-$57) to an 8K page (page n = half of 16K bank n/2).  This
   6+ 0000              ; file names the slots, their registers and addresses, what each slot is
   7+ 0000              ; used for, and which page holds what.  Use:
   8+ 0000              ;   nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_CITY            ; page the city code in at $E000
   9+ 0000              ;   MMU CODE_SLOT e, PAGE_CITY, CODE_ADDR ; (sjasmplus) assemble into it
  10+ 0000              ;
  11+ 0000              ; Memory map (see README.md):
  12+ 0000              ;   slot 0 $0000  Layer 2 sections (32 rows each) while drawing; the sine
  13+ 0000              ;                 table (PAGE_SIN) whenever get_sin reads it
  14+ 0000              ;   slot 1 $2000  zombie page, always mapped: zombies, humans, the HUD
  15+ 0000              ;                 map, the IM 2 table
  16+ 0000              ;   slot 2 $4000  occlusion data; the 320x256 graphics (PAGE_L320) on the
  17+ 0000              ;                 screens outside the game
  18+ 0000              ;   slot 3 $6000  the city bank (always mapped): city_col at $6000,
  19+ 0000              ;                 city_map at $7000, loaded from the level's city file
  20+ 0000              ;   slot 4 $8000  ULA screen (page 10, the first half of bank 5)
  21+ 0000              ;   slot 5 $A000  resident main code, variables, stack (page 11, the unused
  22+ 0000              ;                 second half of bank 5)
  23+ 0000              ;   slot 6 $C000  game logic pages, swapped: player, weapons, menus, level
  24+ 0000              ;                 loading
  25+ 0000              ;   slot 7 $E000  core function pages, swapped: city (Layer 2 drawing), HUD,
  26+ 0000              ;                 keys, sprites; a sprite bank while it is loaded; the
  27+ 0000              ;                 start-up set-up (initialise.asm) once
  28+ 0000              ; So game logic in slot 6 can call any core page in slot 7: main_loop pages
  29+ 0000              ; the keys in at $E000 while the player and weapons pages run at $C000.
  30+ 0000              ; At start-up the NEX loader's default mapping is in place (slot 6 = page
  31+ 0000              ; 0), so the entry point is a stub in PAGE_BOOT at $C000 (boot, zpolice.asm)
  32+ 0000              ; that maps the resident page into slot 5 and jumps to start.
  33+ 0000              ;==============================================================================
  34+ 0000
  35+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  36+ 0000              ; MMU slots: number, NextReg, address
  37+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  38+ 0000              MEMBANK_SIZE            equ $2000       ; 8K a slot / page
  39+ 0000
  40+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0              equ 0
  41+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1              equ 1
  42+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2              equ 2
  43+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3              equ 3
  44+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4              equ 4
  45+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5              equ 5
  46+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6              equ 6
  47+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7              equ 7
  48+ 0000
  49+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER     equ $50
  50+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER     equ $51
  51+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER     equ $52
  52+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER     equ $53
  53+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER     equ $54
  54+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER     equ $55
  55+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER     equ $56
  56+ 0000              MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER     equ $57
  57+ 0000
  58+ 0000              membank0                equ $0000
  59+ 0000              membank1                equ $2000
  60+ 0000              membank2                equ $4000
  61+ 0000              membank3                equ $6000
  62+ 0000              membank4                equ $8000
  63+ 0000              membank5                equ $A000
  64+ 0000              membank6                equ $C000
  65+ 0000              membank7                equ $E000
  66+ 0000
  67+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  68+ 0000              ; What each slot is used for: <use>_SLOT, <use>_MMU (its NextReg) and
  69+ 0000              ; <use>_ADDR (the ORG of code or data assembled for it)
  70+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  71+ 0000              ; slot 0: one 32-row section of a Layer 2 buffer at a time (seg_map etc.)
  72+ 0000              L2SEC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_0
  73+ 0000              L2SEC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  74+ 0000              L2SEC_ADDR              equ membank0
  75+ 0000              ; slot 0 also: the sine table, paged in by get_sin (resident).  Only the
  76+ 0000              ; game logic calls it, never the drawing, and every Layer 2 writer maps its
  77+ 0000              ; own section first, so the two never meet.  Nothing may write to
  78+ 0000              ; $0000-$1FFF while it is mapped.
  79+ 0000              SIN_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_0
  80+ 0000              SIN_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER
  81+ 0000              SIN_ADDR                equ membank0
  82+ 0000
  83+ 0000              ; slot 1: zombie.asm, human.asm, map.asm, interrupts.asm, always mapped
  84+ 0000              ZOMBIE_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_1
  85+ 0000              ZOMBIE_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER
  86+ 0000              ZOMBIE_ADDR             equ membank1
  87+ 0000
  88+ 0000              ; slot 2: occlusion buffer, draw list and building records (OCCLUSION_CULL)
  89+ 0000              OCC_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_2
  90+ 0000              OCC_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  91+ 0000              OCC_ADDR                equ membank2
  92+ 0000              ; slot 2 also: the 320x256 Layer 2 graphics (layer2-320x256.asm), for the
  93+ 0000              ; screens outside the game (menus, load-out, level complete, game over),
  94+ 0000              ; which never draw the city.  The occlusion page goes back before the game
  95+ 0000              ; (l2_game_mode).
  96+ 0000              L320_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_2
  97+ 0000              L320_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_2_REGISTER
  98+ 0000              L320_ADDR               equ membank2
  99+ 0000
 100+ 0000              ; slot 3: the city bank, always mapped: city_col at $6000, city_map at
 101+ 0000              ; $7000, read from the level's city file (level_load.asm) in one go
 102+ 0000              TABLES_SLOT             equ MMU_SLOT_3
 103+ 0000              TABLES_MMU              equ MMU_SLOT_3_REGISTER
 104+ 0000              TABLES_ADDR             equ membank3            ; city_col
 105+ 0000              CITYMAP_ADDR            equ membank3+$1000      ; city_map
 106+ 0000
 107+ 0000              ; slot 4: the ULA screen (bank 5's first 8K: bitmap and attributes)
 108+ 0000              ULA_SLOT                equ MMU_SLOT_4
 109+ 0000              ULA_MMU                 equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 110+ 0000              ULA_ADDR                equ membank4
 111+ 0000              ; slot 4 also: the second city page (city2.asm), over the ULA screen while
 112+ 0000              ; main_loop draws the city (nothing then uses the ULA screen)
 113+ 0000              CITY2_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_4
 114+ 0000              CITY2_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_4_REGISTER
 115+ 0000              CITY2_ADDR              equ membank4
 116+ 0000
 117+ 0000              ; slot 5: resident main code (zpolice.asm), tables, variables, stack
 118+ 0000              MAIN_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_5
 119+ 0000              MAIN_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_5_REGISTER
 120+ 0000              MAIN_ADDR               equ membank5
 121+ 0000
 122+ 0000              ; slot 6: game logic pages, swapped (player, weapons, menu)
 123+ 0000              LOGIC_SLOT              equ MMU_SLOT_6
 124+ 0000              LOGIC_MMU               equ MMU_SLOT_6_REGISTER
 125+ 0000              LOGIC_ADDR              equ membank6
 126+ 0000              ; slot 6 at start-up: the boot stub (the NEX loader maps page 0 there)
 127+ 0000              BOOT_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_6
 128+ 0000              BOOT_ADDR               equ membank6
 129+ 0000
 130+ 0000              ; slot 7: core function pages, swapped (city / Layer 2, HUD, keys, sprites)
 131+ 0000              CODE_SLOT               equ MMU_SLOT_7
 132+ 0000              CODE_MMU                equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 133+ 0000              CODE_ADDR               equ membank7
 134+ 0000              ; slot 7 also: a sprite pattern bank (sprite_data.asm), paged in to run
 135+ 0000              ; its own loader, spr_load_bank
 136+ 0000              SPRBANK_SLOT            equ MMU_SLOT_7
 137+ 0000              SPRBANK_MMU             equ MMU_SLOT_7_REGISTER
 138+ 0000              SPRBANK_ADDR            equ membank7
 139+ 0000
 140+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ 0000              ; 8K pages
 142+ 0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ 0000              PAGE_BOOT               equ 0           ; the NEX entry stub (slot 6 at load)
 144+ 0000              PAGE_CITY               equ 1           ; city.asm: Layer 2 drawing (slot 7)
 145+ 0000              PAGE_HUD                equ 2           ; hud.asm: ULA (Layer 1) HUD (slot 7)
 146+ 0000              PAGE_PLAYER             equ 3           ; player.asm: input, movement,
 147+ 0000                                                      ; collision (slot 6)
 148+ 0000              PAGE_WEAPONS            equ 4           ; weapons.asm: player weapons (slot 6)
 149+ 0000              PAGE_ZOMBIE             equ 5           ; zombie.asm (slot 1, always)
 150+ 0000              PAGE_OCC0               equ 6           ; occlusion buffer, draw list and
 151+ 0000                                                      ; building records (slot 2)
 152+ 0000              PAGE_OCC1               equ 7           ; the city bank: city_col and
 153+ 0000                                                      ; city_map (slot 3, always)
 154+ 0000              PAGE_MENU               equ 8           ; menu.asm: game over, game complete,
 155+ 0000                                                      ; the load error (slot 6)
 156+ 0000              PAGE_SPR0               equ 9           ; sprite_data.asm: sprite pattern
 157+ 0000                                                      ; bank 0 (slot 7 while loading);
 158+ 0000                                                      ; more banks: the next free pages
 159+ 0000              PAGE_ULA0               equ 10          ; the ULA screen, bank 5 (slot 4)
 160+ 0000              PAGE_MAIN               equ 11          ; zpolice.asm, resident (slot 5): the
 161+ 0000                                                      ; second half of bank 5
 162+ 0000              PAGE_INPUT              equ 12          ; input.asm: keyboard, joysticks (slot 7)
 163+ 0000              PAGE_SPRITES            equ 13          ; sprites.asm: hardware sprites
 164+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 7)
 165+ 0000              PAGE_SIN                equ 14          ; sin_tables.asm: the sine table
 166+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 0, read by get_sin)
 167+ 0000              PAGE_INIT               equ 15          ; initialise.asm: start-up set-up,
 168+ 0000                                                      ; initgame (slot 7, once)
 169+ 0000              PAGE_FILE               equ 16          ; file_handler.asm: SD card loading
 170+ 0000                                                      ; and saving (slot 7)
 171+ 0000              PAGE_AUDIO              equ 17          ; audio.asm: sound set-up (slot 7)
 172+ 0000              PAGE_SPECIAL            equ 31          ; specials.asm: special monsters
 173+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 6)
 174+ 0000              PAGE_LOADOUT            equ 32          ; loadout.asm: the load-out screen
 175+ 0000                                                      ; between levels (slot 6)
 176+ 0000              PAGE_KEYDEF             equ 33          ; keydef.asm: the redefine keys
 177+ 0000                                                      ; screen (slot 6)
 178+ 0000              PAGE_CITY2              equ 34          ; city2.asm: more Layer 2 drawing
 179+ 0000                                                      ; (slot 4, with the city page)
 180+ 0000              PAGE_L320               equ 35          ; layer2-320x256.asm: Layer 2 320x256
 181+ 0000                                                      ; graphics for the menu screens (slot 2)
 182+ 0000              PAGE_MAINMENU           equ 36          ; mainmenu.asm: the main menu (slot 6)
 183+ 0000              PAGE_LEVELEND           equ 37          ; levelend.asm: level complete (slot 6)
 184+ 0000              PAGE_L320_BG            equ 86          ; 86-95: a copy of a 320x256 screen's
 185+ 0000                                                      ; background (l320_bg_save), to put back
 186+ 0000                                                      ; under text that changes (l320_restore).
 187+ 0000                                                      ; Shared: the figures' last 10 pages
 188+ 0000                                                      ; (shared_pg; gfx_reload puts them back)
 189+ 0000              PAGE_GFX0               equ 38          ; the figures' graphics (pages 38-95,
 190+ 0000                                                      ; GFX_PAGES_MAX at most), loaded from
 191+ 0000                                                      ; ZPDATA/SPRITES.ZPG at start-up; each
 192+ 0000                                                      ; mapped at $C000 (slot 6) to draw
 193+ 0000              GFX_SHARED              equ PAGE_L320_BG - PAGE_GFX0    ; (its first shared page)
 194+ 0000              PAGE_LEVEL              equ 30          ; level_load.asm: level and city
 195+ 0000                                                      ; files (slot 6); pages 18-29 are
 196+ 0000                                                      ; the Layer 2 buffers
 197+ 0000
 198+ 0000              ; Layer 2 double buffer, in 16K banks (NextReg $12 / $13 take banks; the
 199+ 0000              ; pages are bank * 2).  Layer 2 is clipped to 192 rows, so each buffer
 200+ 0000              ; uses three banks.
 201+ 0000              L2_BANK_A               equ 9           ; 16K banks 9-11 (pages 18-23)
 202+ 0000              L2_BANK_B               equ 12          ; 16K banks 12-14 (pages 24-29)
 203+ 0000              PAGE_L2_A               equ L2_BANK_A*2
 204+ 0000              PAGE_L2_B               equ L2_BANK_B*2
 205+ 0000
 206+ 0000              PAGE_ROM                equ $FF         ; MMU value: ROM in slots 0-1

 132  0000
 133  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 134  0000              ; Tuning constants
 135  0000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136  0000              ; Scale: one map tile (cell) is 20 m x 20 m = 256 world units, and one
 137  0000              ; height unit (building heights, the ceiling, the pad) is 10 m = 128 world
 138  0000              ; units.  World units are the same size on every axis, so 1 m = 12.8 units
 139  0000              ; and 1 unit = 7.8 cm.  The city is 64 x 64 tiles = 1280 m.
 140  0000              ; Speeds are per rendered frame, so real speed depends on the frame rate
 141  0000              ; (figures below are at 14 fps).
 142  0000              GRID            equ 64          ; the city is GRID x GRID tiles (gentables.py)
 143  0000              ; A city_map byte: bits 0-4 the cell code (0 road, 1-15 building height

 290  0000              ; Game time (clock_step): ticks of the 50 Hz frame interrupt (isr_ticks).
 291  0000              ; Per-frame values (speeds, steps) were tuned at ASSUMED_FPS frames a

 734  0000              ; Self-modified opcodes for the line drawer

 737  0000              OP_INC_H        equ $24
 738  0000              OP_DEC_H        equ $25
 739  0000              ; and for scale_comp's barrel shift (the second byte, after $ED: zpatch)
 740  0000              OP_BSLA         equ $28             ; bsla de,b

 742  0000
 743  0000              ; HL = HL * GRID  (a map row offset)
 744  0000              ; DE = -DE (vproj)
 745  0000                      MACRO NEG_DE
 746  0000 ~                    xor a
 747  0000 ~                    sub e
 748  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 749  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 750  0000 ~                    sub d
 751  0000 ~                    ld d,a
 752  0000                      ENDM
 753  0000
 754  0000              ; HL = n (>= 0), BC = R (zpatch's reciprocal for Z) -> A = round(n * 128 /
 755  0000              ; Z) as scale_comp, after its shift: n over 511 clamped; P = n_lo R / 256 +
 756  0000              ; 256 (the rounding, first: at most 65535), plus R if bit 8 of n is set (the
 757  0000              ; carry bit 16); A = bits 9-16 of P.  Uses DE.  (vproj)
 758  0000                      MACRO VP_SCALE
 759  0000 ~                    ld a,h
 760  0000 ~                    cp 2
 761  0000 ~                    jr c,$+5
 762  0000 ~                    ld hl,511
 763  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 764  0000 ~                    ld e,c
 765  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rl
 766  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 767  0000 ~                    ld d,l
 768  0000 ~                    ld e,b
 769  0000 ~                    mul d,e                         ; n_lo Rh
 770  0000 ~                    add a,e
 771  0000 ~                    ld e,a
 772  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 773  0000 ~                    adc a,1
 774  0000 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = n_lo R / 256 + 256, carry 0
 775  0000 ~                    bit 0,h
 776  0000 ~                    jr z,$+5
 777  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 778  0000 ~                    add hl,bc                       ; + 256 n_hi R / 256: carry = bit 16
 779  0000 ~                    ex de,hl
 780  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 781  0000 ~                    rra
 782  0000                      ENDM
 783  0000
 784  0000              ; The cell walks' call of try_cell (draw_row, occ_row), skipped for a cell
 785  0000              ; whose centre (the walk's yaw-space X, Z1 in HL', DE') is surely out of
 786  0000              ; view: in level flight |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R (outside the left or right
 787  0000              ; edge), pitched Z1 < -WALK_R (behind: no multiply by draw_bld's cull_c).
 788  0000              ; WALK_R is over draw_bld's BLD_R, so every building it skips draw_bld
 789  0000              ; would reject, and the 64 over leaves room for a figure standing at a
 790  0000              ; street cell's edge (an off-screen figure draws nothing and notes
 791  0000              ; nothing: fig_draw returns before fig_seen).  The walk still steps every
 792  0000              ; cell, so the cells drawn have the same positions.  Uses A, BC'.
 793  0000              WALK_R          equ 320
 794  0000                      MACRO WALK_TRY
 795  0000 ~                    exx
 796  0000 ~                    ld a,(pitch)
 797  0000 ~                    or a
 798  0000 ~                    jr nz,.pt
 799  0000 ~                    ld b,h
 800  0000 ~                    ld c,l
 801  0000 ~                    bit 7,b
 802  0000 ~                    jr z,.ap
 803  0000 ~                    xor a
 804  0000 ~                    sub c
 805  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 806  0000 ~                    sbc a,a
 807  0000 ~                    sub b
 808  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X|
 809  0000 ~            .ap:    ld a,c
 810  0000 ~                    sub e
 811  0000 ~                    ld c,a
 812  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 813  0000 ~                    sbc a,d
 814  0000 ~                    ld b,a                          ; |X| - Z1
 815  0000 ~                    ld a,c
 816  0000 ~                    sub low WALK_R
 817  0000 ~                    ld a,b
 818  0000 ~                    sbc a,high WALK_R
 819  0000 ~                    exx
 820  0000 ~                    jp p,.out                       ; |X| - Z1 >= WALK_R
 821  0000 ~                    jr .try
 822  0000 ~            .pt:    ld a,e
 823  0000 ~                    add a,low WALK_R
 824  0000 ~                    ld a,d
 825  0000 ~                    adc a,high WALK_R
 826  0000 ~                    exx
 827  0000 ~                    jp m,.out                       ; Z1 + WALK_R < 0
 828  0000 ~            .try:   call try_cell
 829  0000 ~            .out:
 830  0000                      ENDM
 831  0000
 832  0000                      MACRO ROWOFS
 833  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 834  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 835  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 836  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 837  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 838  0000 ~                    add hl,hl
 839  0000                      ENDM
 840  0000
 841  0000              ; A building's 8 corners (vtx, 16 bytes each; index = x + 2*z + 4*top) from
 842  0000              ; corner 0, component C (0 X, 2 Y, 4 Z) at a time: v1 = v0 + vx, v3 = v1 +
 843  0000              ; vz, v2 = v0 + vz (vx, vz: vecs0, its edge vectors), and each top corner
 844  0000              ; its bottom corner + vy (vy_vec, the vertical edge).  The sums the corners
 845  0000              ; share are made once, in registers (draw_bld, city.asm).
 846  0000                      MACRO VBOX C
 847  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 848  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)                 ; vx
 849  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)               ; vz
 850  0000 ~                    push hl
 851  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 852  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 853  0000 ~                    push hl
 854  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 855  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 856  0000 ~                    ld de,(vy_vec+C)                ; vy
 857  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 858  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7 = v3 + vy
 859  0000 ~                    pop hl
 860  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 861  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5 = v1 + vy
 862  0000 ~                    pop hl
 863  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 864  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz
 865  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 866  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+96+C),hl                ; v6 = v2 + vy
 867  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)
 868  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 869  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0 + vy
 870  0000                      ENDM
 871  0000              ; The same for a component of vy that is 0 (X always; Z in level flight):
 872  0000              ; each top corner is its bottom corner
 873  0000                      MACRO VBOX0 C
 874  0000 ~                    ld hl,(vtx+C)                   ; v0
 875  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+64+C),hl                ; v4 = v0
 876  0000 ~                    ld de,(vecs0+C)
 877  0000 ~                    ld bc,(vecs0+6+C)
 878  0000 ~                    push hl
 879  0000 ~                    add hl,de
 880  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+16+C),hl                ; v1 = v0 + vx
 881  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+80+C),hl                ; v5
 882  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 883  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+48+C),hl                ; v3 = v1 + vz
 884  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+112+C),hl               ; v7
 885  0000 ~                    pop hl
 886  0000 ~                    add hl,bc
 887  0000 ~                    ld (vtx+32+C),hl                ; v2 = v0 + vz

 935  A061                      INCLUDE "levels.asm"            ; the current level's record
# file opened: levels.asm
   1+ A061              ;==============================================================================
   2+ A061              ; Z-POLICE - the current level's settings (resident, so any page can read
   3+ A061              ; them)
   4+ A061              ;
   5+ A061              ; level_cur holds the record of the level being played, loaded from its file
   6+ A061              ; ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL by load_level (level_load.asm).  LV_SIZE bytes:
   7+ A061              ;   +0  LV_NUM          level number
   8+ A061              ;   +1  LV_NAME         city name, 8 characters (ASCII, space padded)
   9+ A061              ;   +9  LV_ZOMBIES      number of zombies a wave (at most NZOMB)
  10+ A061              ;   +10 LV_WAVES        number of zombie waves (1..LV_MAX_WAVES)
  11+ A061              ;   +11 LV_FAST         number of fast zombies (of LV_ZOMBIES)
  12+ A061              ;   +12 LV_VIEW_R       draw distance in tiles, 2..VIEW_R (fewer: night or
  13+ A061              ;                       fog); load_level sets view_r / dot_r from it
  14+ A061              ;   +13 LV_WAVE_DATA    the special monsters of each wave, waves 1 to
  15+ A061              ;                       LV_MAX_WAVES (wave 1 is the level's start), LV_WAVE_REC
  16+ A061              ;                       bytes each:
  17+ A061              ;         +0  LV_SPECIAL_ID   LV_SPEC_SLOTS special types (SPEC_*;
  18+ A061              ;                             SPEC_NONE, 255: none in that place)
  19+ A061              ;         +5  LV_SPECIAL      how many of each (in the same places)
  20+ A061              ; The levels and their cities are made by gentables.py (ZPDATA/); a level
  21+ A061              ; file can be replaced by a hand-made one (or its text form, .TXL, edited).
  22+ A061              ;==============================================================================
  23+ A061
  24+ A061              LV_NUM          equ 0
  25+ A061              LV_NAME         equ 1
  26+ A061              LV_NAME_LEN     equ 8
  27+ A061              LV_ZOMBIES      equ LV_NAME+LV_NAME_LEN
  28+ A061              LV_WAVES        equ LV_ZOMBIES+1
  29+ A061              LV_FAST         equ LV_WAVES+1
  30+ A061              LV_VIEW_R       equ LV_FAST+1
  31+ A061              LV_WAVE_DATA    equ LV_VIEW_R+1
  32+ A061              LV_MAX_WAVES    equ 10              ; waves a level can have specials for
  33+ A061              LV_SPEC_SLOTS   equ 5               ; special types a wave
  34+ A061              LV_SPECIAL_ID   equ 0               ; (in a wave's data) the types,
  35+ A061              LV_SPECIAL      equ LV_SPEC_SLOTS   ;   then how many of each
  36+ A061              LV_WAVE_REC     equ 2*LV_SPEC_SLOTS
  37+ A061              LV_SIZE         equ LV_WAVE_DATA+LV_MAX_WAVES*LV_WAVE_REC   ; 113 bytes
  38+ A061                      ASSERT LV_SIZE == 113           ; (gentables.py writes it)
  39+ A061              ; Special monster types in the level files (specials.asm: spec_types)
  40+ A061              SPEC_GHOST      equ 0
  41+ A061              SPEC_BANSHEE    equ 1
  42+ A061              SPEC_GHOUL      equ 2
  43+ A061              SPEC_LICH       equ 3
  44+ A061              SPEC_DEVIL      equ 4               ; the final boss (devil.asm): alone, last
  45+ A061              SPEC_IDS        equ 5               ; (how many types)
  46+ A061              SPEC_CLUSTER    equ 5               ; not a monster: the wave's zombies spawn in
  47+ A061                                                  ; this many clusters (zcluster, zombie.asm)
  48+ A061                      ASSERT SPEC_CLUSTER >= SPEC_IDS ; (spec_wave skips it)
  49+ A061              SPEC_NONE       equ 255
  50+ A061
  51+ A061              ; -> HL = the current level's record
  52+ A061              level_entry:
  53+ A061 21 65 A0             ld hl,level_cur
  54+ A064 C9                   ret
  55+ A065
  56+ A065 00 00 00...  level_cur:  ds LV_SIZE                  ; the level being played (load_level)
  57+ A0D6
# file closed: levels.asm

 102+ A143              ; Wait for the start of the next video frame (the raster reaching line 192)
 103+ A143              menu_frame:
 104+ A143 CD 4E A1     .in:    call menu_line                  ; let any current blanking end
 105+ A146 30 FB                jr nc,.in
 106+ A148 CD 4E A1     .out:   call menu_line                  ; then wait for the next one
 107+ A14B 38 FB                jr c,.out
 108+ A14D C9                   ret

 110+ A14E              ; Carry clear if the raster is at line 192 or later (blanking).  The line is
 111+ A14E              ; read as high byte ($1E), low byte ($1F), high byte again: if the high
 112+ A14E              ; byte changed in between (line 255 -> 256) the pair is torn, so read again.
 113+ A14E              menu_line:
 114+ A14E 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 115+ A151 3E 1E                ld a,$1E

 117+ A155 04                   inc b

 119+ A158 05                   dec b

 122+ A15D 04                   inc b
 123+ A15E ED 50                in d,(c)                        ; low byte
 124+ A160 05                   dec b

 126+ A163 ED 79                out (c),a

 129+ A168 BB                   cp e

 132+ A16D C0                   ret nz                          ; line >= 256 (carry clear)

  33+ A372              ; DMA+ (zxnDDMA, core 3.03.00, port $6B only; REAL_HARDWARE builds):
  34+ A372              ; docs/ZXNDDMA.md
  35+ A372              DDMA_MODE                    equ $df    ; then the flags: each sets them all
  36+ A372                                                      ; (with DDMA_FLAG_XY: X lo, X hi, Y)
  37+ A372              DDMA_FILL_VALUE              equ $f7    ; then the value
  38+ A372              DDMA_ROW_LEN                 equ $e3    ; 2D: then bytes a row (word)
  39+ A372              DDMA_ROWS                    equ $e7    ; 2D: then the rows (word)
  40+ A372              DDMA_B_STRIDE                equ $ef    ; 2D: then port B's stride (word)
  41+ A372              DDMA_A_EXT                   equ $d7    ; then port A address bits 23:16
  42+ A372              DDMA_B_EXT                   equ $db    ; then port B address bits 23:16
  43+ A372              DDMA_A_STRIDE                equ $eb    ; 2D: then port A's stride (word)
  44+ A372              DDMA_TRANS_COL               equ $f3    ; then the transparent colour
  45+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_PHYS               equ %00000001  ; 22-bit physical addresses
  46+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_2D                 equ %00000010  ; rows (row length, rows, strides)
  47+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_TRANS              equ %00000100  ; source bytes = the colour skipped
  48+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_FILL               equ %00001000  ; no reads: the fill value
  49+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_XY                 equ %00010000  ; port B from a Layer 2 X,Y
  50+ A372              DDMA_FLAG_HIDDEN             equ %00100000  ;   on the hidden screen ($13)
  51+ A372              ; A filled rectangle in the buffer being drawn, by its physical address
  52+ A372              ; (seg_base's pages): no paging (dd_rect, city.asm)
  53+ A372              DDMA_RECT                    equ DDMA_FLAG_PHYS|DDMA_FLAG_2D|DDMA_FLAG_FILL

  76+ A385              ; DMA fill: HL = destination, BC = length (non-zero), A = the byte.  Any
  77+ A385              ; memory mapped in now (the Layer 2 sections in slot 0, the occlusion page,

1078  A4A4              ; Start the level `level`: from the load-out screen, after newGame and after
1079  A4A4              ; each level completed (level_complete_screen).  The VTOL goes back onto the base pad, level and
1080  A4A4              ; still; its hit points, weapons and ammo carry on.  The level's files are
1081  A4A4              ; loaded and everything in the city is set up afresh.

1097  A4C8 3E 01                ld a,1

1235  A606
1236  A606              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1237  A606              ; After a frame (its view shown) that started a level (WP_START: no figures
1238  A606              ; drawn if their pages are being read back) or the devil's wave (WP_DEVIL:
1239  A606              ; it isn't drawn yet): PREPARE FOR COMBAT over the view (as PAUSED is)
1240  A606              ; while
1241  A606              ;   * at a level's start, the figures' pages a screen's background copy
1242  A606              ;     (shared_pg) or the devil's graphics (devil_gfx) went over are read
1243  A606              ;     back from the figures' file (gfx_stale, gfx_reload);
1244  A606              ;   * in the devil's wave, its graphics go over the other monsters' pages
1245  A606              ;     (devil_load: from the figures' kept pages on, gfx_keep);
1246  A606              ; (one can't be read: the SD card's at fault, the load error screen), and
1247  A606              ; for WPREP_TICKS interrupts (2 s) at least from its start (isr_ticks; the
1248  A606              ; interrupts are off while the SD card is read, so a long read adds to it).
1249  A606              ; Then the box goes and the game runs.
1250  A606              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1251  A606              WPREP_ROW       equ 7               ; ULA character row and column of the box
1252  A606              WPREP_COL       equ 6
1253  A606              WPREP_TICKS     equ 100             ; at least 2 s (interrupts)
1254  A606              WP_START        equ 0               ; wave_prep bits: a level's start,
1255  A606              WP_DEVIL        equ 1               ;   the devil's wave
1256  A606              wave_prepare:
1257  A606 3A 93 A6             ld a,(wave_prep)
1258  A609 32 94 A6             ld (wp_what),a
1259  A60C AF                   xor a
1260  A60D 32 93 A6             ld (wave_prep),a
1261  A610 21 00 00             ld hl,0
1262  A613 22 9D 3C             ld (isr_ticks),hl               ; (one instruction: no tearing)
1263  A616 21 69 A6             ld hl,txt_wprep
1264  A619 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1265  A61C 0E 17                ld c,PAUSE_ATTR
1266  A61E CD F9 A0             call menu_print
1267  A621 ED 91 56 1E          nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_LEVEL    ; (level_load.asm)
1268  A625 3A 94 A6             ld a,(wp_what)
1269  A628 CB 47                bit WP_START,a
1270  A62A 28 11                jr z,.dv
1271  A62C CD 95 A6             call gfx_stale                  ; pages to read back?
1272  A62F 38 05                jr c,.fresh
1273  A631 CD C1 C2             call gfx_reload
1274  A634 38 13                jr c,.err
1275  A636 AF           .fresh: xor a                           ; the figures' pages all theirs
1276  A637 32 9B A8             ld (shared_pg),a
1277  A63A 32 64 A8             ld (devil_gfx),a
1278  A63D 3A 94 A6     .dv:    ld a,(wp_what)
1279  A640 CB 4F                bit WP_DEVIL,a
1280  A642 28 0C                jr z,wp_wait
1281  A644 CD 1F C3             call devil_load                 ; its graphics over the others'
1282  A647 30 07                jr nc,wp_wait
1283  A649 ED 91 56 08  .err:   nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_MENU     ; couldn't: the SD card's at fault
1284  A64D C3 30 C1             jp load_error_screen            ; (menu.asm)
1285  A650              wp_wait:                                ; (tests: zptest skips the wait here)
1286  A650 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)
1287  A653 11 64 00             ld de,WPREP_TICKS
1288  A656 B7                   or a
1289  A657 ED 52                sbc hl,de
1290  A659 38 F5                jr c,wp_wait
1291  A65B CD 7C A7             call clock_reset                ; (no game time passed meanwhile)
1292  A65E 21 7E A6             ld hl,txt_wprep_off             ; the box gone: the view again
1293  A661 11 06 07             ld de,WPREP_ROW<<8 | WPREP_COL
1294  A664 0E 47                ld c,VIEW_ATTR
1295  A666 C3 F9 A0             jp menu_print

1297  A669 20 50 52 45  txt_wprep:      db " PREPARE FOR COMBAT ", 0
1297  A66D 50 41 52 45
1297  A671 20 46 4F 52
1297  A675 20 43 4F 4D
1297  A679 42 41 54 20
1297  A67D 00
1298  A67E 20 20 20 20  txt_wprep_off:  db "                    ", 0
1298  A682 20 20 20 20
1298  A686 20 20 20 20
1298  A68A 20 20 20 20
1298  A68E 20 20 20 20
1298  A692 00
1299  A693                      ASSERT txt_wprep_off - txt_wprep == $ - txt_wprep_off
1300  A693 00           wave_prep:      db 0                    ; wave_prepare after this frame: bits
1301  A694                                                      ; WP_START, WP_DEVIL
1302  A694 00           wp_what:        db 0                    ; (wave_prepare: what it's for)
1303  A695
1304  A695              ; A = the first figure page to read back from the figures' file at a
1305  A695              ; level's start: a screen's background copy took the shared ones
1306  A695              ; (shared_pg), the devil's graphics went over those from the kept ones on
1307  A695              ; (devil_gfx, gfx_keep).  Carry set if none (or no graphics at all).
1308  A695              gfx_stale:
1309  A695 0E 3A                ld c,GFX_PAGES_MAX
1310  A697 3A 9B A8             ld a,(shared_pg)
1311  A69A B7                   or a
1312  A69B 28 02                jr z,.d
1313  A69D 0E 30                ld c,GFX_SHARED
1314  A69F 3A 64 A8     .d:     ld a,(devil_gfx)
1315  A6A2 B7                   or a
1316  A6A3 28 07                jr z,.c
1317  A6A5 3A 63 A8             ld a,(gfx_keep)
1318  A6A8 B9                   cp c
1319  A6A9 30 01                jr nc,.c
1320  A6AB 4F                   ld c,a
1321  A6AC 3A 62 A8     .c:     ld a,(gfx_pages)
1322  A6AF B7                   or a
1323  A6B0 37                   scf
1324  A6B1 C8                   ret z                           ; (no graphics)
1325  A6B2 3D                   dec a                           ; its last page before the first stale
1326  A6B3 B9                   cp c                            ; one: carry, none to read
1327  A6B4 79                   ld a,c
1328  A6B5 C9                   ret
1329  A6B6
1330  A6B6              ;==============================================================================
1331  A6B6              ; Frames per second, shown on the ULA layer above Layer 2.
1332  A6B6              ;
1333  A6B6              ; Interrupts stay off (the span filler borrows SP), so time is taken from the
1334  A6B6              ; raster: vtick reads the current video line and counts a new 50Hz video
1335  A6B6              ; frame whenever the line number has gone backwards.  It must be called at
1336  A6B6              ; least once per video frame (~560K T at 28MHz); the main loop and draw_cell
1337  A6B6              ; do that.  Every 50 video frames (1 second) the number of frames rendered
1338  A6B6              ; becomes the FPS figure.
1339  A6B6              ;==============================================================================
1340  A6B6                  IFDEF DRAW_FPS
1341  A6B6 ~            vtick:
1342  A6B6 ~                    ld bc,$243B
1343  A6B6 ~                    ld a,$1E
1344  A6B6 ~                    out (c),a
1345  A6B6 ~                    inc b
1346  A6B6 ~                    in d,(c)                        ; line MSB
1347  A6B6 ~                    dec b
1348  A6B6 ~                    ld a,$1F
1349  A6B6 ~                    out (c),a
1350  A6B6 ~                    inc b
1351  A6B6 ~                    in e,(c)                        ; line LSB
1352  A6B6 ~                    dec b
1353  A6B6 ~                    ld a,$1E
1354  A6B6 ~                    out (c),a
1355  A6B6 ~                    inc b
1356  A6B6 ~                    in a,(c)
1357  A6B6 ~                    cp d
1358  A6B6 ~                    jr nz,vtick                     ; MSB changed mid-read: try again
1359  A6B6 ~                    and 1
1360  A6B6 ~                    ld d,a                          ; DE = video line 0..311
1361  A6B6 ~                    ld hl,(fps_line)
1362  A6B6 ~                    ld (fps_line),de
1363  A6B6 ~                    or a
1364  A6B6 ~                    sbc hl,de                       ; previous - current
1365  A6B6 ~                    ret c
1366  A6B6 ~                    ret z
1367  A6B6 ~                    ld hl,fps_vframes               ; line went backwards: new frame
1368  A6B6 ~                    inc (hl)
1369  A6B6 ~                    ret
1370  A6B6 ~
1371  A6B6 ~            ; Once per rendered frame, after the flip
1372  A6B6 ~            fps_tick:
1373  A6B6 ~                    call vtick
1374  A6B6 ~                    ld hl,fps_count
1375  A6B6 ~                    inc (hl)
1376  A6B6 ~                    ld a,(fps_vframes)
1377  A6B6 ~                    cp 50
1378  A6B6 ~                    ret c
1379  A6B6 ~                    sub 50
1380  A6B6 ~                    ld (fps_vframes),a
1381  A6B6 ~                    ld a,(fps_count)
1382  A6B6 ~                    ld (fps_value),a
1383  A6B6 ~                    xor a
1384  A6B6 ~                    ld (fps_count),a
1385  A6B6 ~                    jp fps_draw                     ; HUD page (paged in by main_loop)
1386  A6B6                  ENDIF
1387  A6B6
1388  A6B6              ; A = NextReg number -> A = its value
1389  A6B6              read_nextreg:
1390  A6B6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
1391  A6B9 ED 79                out (c),a
1392  A6BB 04                   inc b
1393  A6BC ED 78                in a,(c)
1394  A6BE C9                   ret
1395  A6BF
1396  A6BF              ; Select the shadow Layer 2 buffer for drawing: remember the 8K page of its
1397  A6BF              ; first row.  Sections are then paged in on demand by seg_map / line_seg.
1398  A6BF              map_shadow:
1399  A6BF 3E 13                ld a,$13
1400  A6C1 CD B6 A6             call read_nextreg
1401  A6C4 87                   add a,a                         ; 16K bank -> 8K page
1402  A6C5 32 02 B6             ld (seg_base),a
1403  A6C8 C9                   ret
1404  A6C9
1405  A6C9              ; Back from the screens outside the game (320x256, layer2-320x256.asm) to
1406  A6C9              ; the game's Layer 2, 256x192 and hidden, and the occlusion page back in
1407  A6C9              ; slot 2 where the 320x256 page was.  (Nothing changes if it wasn't.)
1408  A6C9              l2_game_mode:
1409  A6C9 ED 91 52 23          nextreg L320_MMU,PAGE_L320
1410  A6CD CD 56 40             call l320_mode256
1411  A6D0 ED 91 52 06          nextreg OCC_MMU,PAGE_OCC0
1412  A6D4 C9                   ret
1413  A6D5
1414  A6D5              ; Show the shadow buffer and make the old active buffer the new shadow
1415  A6D5              l2_flip:
1416  A6D5 3E 12                ld a,$12
1417  A6D7 CD B6 A6             call read_nextreg
1418  A6DA 5F                   ld e,a                          ; old active
1419  A6DB 3E 13                ld a,$13
1420  A6DD CD B6 A6             call read_nextreg
1421  A6E0 ED 92 12             nextreg $12,a                   ; shadow -> active
1422  A6E3 7B                   ld a,e
1423  A6E4 ED 92 13             nextreg $13,a                   ; old active -> shadow
1424  A6E7 C9                   ret
1425  A6E8
1426  A6E8              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1427  A6E8              ; Layer 2 writes go through MMU slot 0 ($0000-$1FFF) only.  Each 8K page of
1428  A6E8              ; the buffer is a 32-row section, so row y is page seg_base + y/32 and its
1429  A6E8              ; pixels are at (y & 31)*256 + x.  Sections are paged in as drawing reaches
1430  A6E8              ; them.  Slots 4-5 keep the ULA screen.
1431  A6E8              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1432  A6E8
1433  A6E8              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1434  A6E8              ; Screen shake, when the VTOL hits a building (player.asm sets shake_t to
1435  A6E8              ; SHAKE_LEN), and heavier when a wreck hits the ground (shake_big:
1436  A6E8              ; SHAKE_BIG_LEN of shake_big_xy, up to 4 pixels).  Each rendered frame, as it
1437  A6E8              ; is shown, the Layer 2 view is offset by the next pair of the table
1438  A6E8              ; (shake_tab) through the scroll registers, dying away; the last pair (0, 0)
1439  A6E8              ; puts it back, and the table back to shake_xy.  Only
1440  A6E8              ; Layer 2 moves: the HUD is on the ULA.  (X wraps at 256, Y at 192: -n is
1441  A6E8              ; 256-n and 192-n.  An edge row or column of the view shows the far side's
1442  A6E8              ; meanwhile.)
1443  A6E8              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1444  A6E8              SHAKE_LEN       equ 6               ; rendered frames (about half a second)
1445  A6E8              SHAKE_BIG_LEN   equ 16              ; a wreck's (over a second)
1446  A6E8              shake_tick:
1447  A6E8 3A 60 A8             ld a,(shake_t)
1448  A6EB B7                   or a
1449  A6EC C8                   ret z
1450  A6ED 21 53 A8             ld hl,fsteps                    ; (frames' worth)
1451  A6F0 96                   sub (hl)
1452  A6F1 30 01                jr nc,.k
1453  A6F3 AF                   xor a
1454  A6F4 32 60 A8     .k:     ld (shake_t),a
1455  A6F7 2A 5E A8             ld hl,(shake_tab)
1456  A6FA 20 07                jr nz,.t
1457  A6FC 11 24 A8             ld de,shake_xy                  ; (the last: the usual table again)
1458  A6FF ED 53 5E A8          ld (shake_tab),de
1459  A703 87           .t:     add a,a
1460  A704 ED 31                add hl,a
1461  A706 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1462  A707 ED 92 16             nextreg $16,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll X
1463  A70A 23                   inc hl
1464  A70B 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1465  A70C ED 92 17             nextreg $17,a                   ; Layer 2 scroll Y
1466  A70F C9                   ret
1467  A710
1468  A710              ; The heavy shake (a wreck hitting the ground), over any going
1469  A710              shake_big:
1470  A710 21 30 A8             ld hl,shake_big_xy
1471  A713 22 5E A8             ld (shake_tab),hl
1472  A716 3E 10                ld a,SHAKE_BIG_LEN
1473  A718 32 60 A8             ld (shake_t),a
1474  A71B C9                   ret
1475  A71C
1476  A71C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1477  A71C              ; Game time.  Once a frame (main_loop) clock_step works out:
1478  A71C              ;   dt      the ticks (isr_ticks, 50 Hz) since the last frame, 0..DT_MAX
1479  A71C              ;           (at most DT_MAX: a stall doesn't jump the game);
1480  A71C              ;   fs      the frames' worth of them at ASSUMED_FPS, 8.8 (fs_tab): what
1481  A71C              ;           per-frame speeds are scaled by (fs_mul, fs_amount);
1482  A71C              ;   fsteps  whole frames' worth this frame (fs added up, fraction kept):
1483  A71C              ;           how many times a per-frame step (a key's speed change, a
1484  A71C              ;           damping step) happens this frame, 0, 1, 2 ...;
1485  A71C              ;   game_now  the game's own clock (+dt), only while it runs.
1486  A71C              ; Intervals count down by dt.  Game time only passes in main_loop: after
1487  A71C              ; anything that holds it up (a pause, PREPARE FOR COMBAT, a level's load)
1488  A71C              ; clock_reset starts the count afresh.  The tests run without interrupts:
1489  A71C              ; with clk_test set (zptest), every frame is CLK_TEST_DT ticks and one whole
1490  A71C              ; frame (fs 1.0).
1491  A71C              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1492  A71C              clock_step:
1493  A71C                  IFNDEF RELEASE
1494  A71C 3A 5D A8             ld a,(clk_test)
1495  A71F B7                   or a
1496  A720 28 0A                jr z,.real
1497  A722 21 00 01             ld hl,256                       ; (a whole frame)
1498  A725 22 59 A8             ld (fsinv),hl
1499  A728 3E 04                ld a,CLK_TEST_DT
1500  A72A 18 31                jr .set
1501  A72C              .real:
1502  A72C                  ENDIF
1503  A72C CD 83 A7             call clk_read                   ; HL = isr_ticks
1504  A72F ED 5B 57 A8          ld de,(clk_last)
1505  A733 22 57 A8             ld (clk_last),hl
1506  A736 B7                   or a
1507  A737 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; ticks since (16-bit: right across
1508  A739 7C                   ld a,h                          ; the roll-over too)
1509  A73A B7                   or a
1510  A73B 20 05                jr nz,.max
1511  A73D 7D                   ld a,l
1512  A73E FE 09                cp DT_MAX+1
1513  A740 38 02                jr c,.ok
1514  A742 3E 08        .max:   ld a,DT_MAX
1515  A744 21 FF A7     .ok:    ld hl,fsinv_tab
1516  A747 ED 31                add hl,a
1517  A749 ED 31                add hl,a
1518  A74B 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1519  A74C 23                   inc hl
1520  A74D 56                   ld d,(hl)
1521  A74E ED 53 59 A8          ld (fsinv),de
1522  A752 21 ED A7             ld hl,fs_tab
1523  A755 ED 31                add hl,a
1524  A757 ED 31                add hl,a
1525  A759 5E                   ld e,(hl)
1526  A75A 23                   inc hl
1527  A75B 56                   ld d,(hl)
1528  A75C EB                   ex de,hl
1529  A75D 32 50 A8     .set:   ld (dt),a
1530  A760 22 51 A8             ld (fs),hl
1531  A763 2A 55 A8             ld hl,(game_now)
1532  A766 ED 31                add hl,a
1533  A768 22 55 A8             ld (game_now),hl
1534  A76B 2A 51 A8             ld hl,(fs)
1535  A76E 3A 54 A8             ld a,(fs_acc)                   ; whole frames: fs added up
1536  A771 85                   add a,l
1537  A772 32 54 A8             ld (fs_acc),a
1538  A775 7C                   ld a,h
1539  A776 CE 00                adc a,0
1540  A778 32 53 A8             ld (fsteps),a
1541  A77B C9                   ret
1542  A77C
1543  A77C              ; Start counting game time afresh from now (nothing passed meanwhile)
1544  A77C              clock_reset:
1545  A77C CD 83 A7             call clk_read
1546  A77F 22 57 A8             ld (clk_last),hl
1547  A782 C9                   ret
1548  A783
1549  A783              ; HL = isr_ticks, read whole (the interrupt may change it between the
1550  A783              ; bytes: read until two reads agree)
1551  A783              clk_read:
1552  A783 2A 9D 3C             ld hl,(isr_ticks)
1553  A786 ED 5B 9D 3C          ld de,(isr_ticks)
1554  A78A 7D                   ld a,l
1555  A78B BB                   cp e
1556  A78C 20 F5                jr nz,clk_read
1557  A78E 7C                   ld a,h
1558  A78F BA                   cp d
1559  A790 20 F1                jr nz,clk_read
1560  A792 C9                   ret
1561  A793
1562  A793              ; HL = HL * fs >> 8: a signed per-frame amount -> this frame's (|HL| * fs
1563  A793              ; under 65536).  Preserves IX, IY.
1564  A793              fs_mul:
1565  A793 ED 5B 51 A8          ld de,(fs)
1566  A797                      ; fall through
1567  A797
1568  A797              ; HL = HL * DE >> 8: HL signed, DE an unsigned 8.8 factor under 8.0 (the
1569  A797              ; result under 32768).  Preserves IX, IY.
1570  A797              mul_88:
1571  A797 7C                   ld a,h
1572  A798 B7                   or a                            ; (S: the sign)
1573  A799 F5                   push af
1574  A79A CD 91 AE             call abs_hl
1575  A79D ED 53 5B A8          ld (m88_f),de
1576  A7A1 E5                   push hl
1577  A7A2 7B                   ld a,e                          ; |x| * the factor's fraction, >> 8
1578  A7A3 55                   ld d,l
1579  A7A4 ED 30                mul d,e
1580  A7A6 4A                   ld c,d
1581  A7A7 E1                   pop hl
1582  A7A8 E5                   push hl
1583  A7A9 3A 5B A8             ld a,(m88_f)
1584  A7AC 5F                   ld e,a
1585  A7AD 54                   ld d,h
1586  A7AE ED 30                mul d,e
1587  A7B0 7B                   ld a,e
1588  A7B1 81                   add a,c
1589  A7B2 6F                   ld l,a
1590  A7B3 7A                   ld a,d
1591  A7B4 CE 00                adc a,0
1592  A7B6 67                   ld h,a
1593  A7B7 D1                   pop de                          ; + |x| * its whole part
1594  A7B8 3A 5C A8             ld a,(m88_f+1)
1595  A7BB B7                   or a
1596  A7BC 28 04                jr z,.s
1597  A7BE 19           .w:     add hl,de
1598  A7BF 3D                   dec a
1599  A7C0 20 FC                jr nz,.w
1600  A7C2 F1           .s:     pop af
1601  A7C3 F0                   ret p
1602  A7C4 C3 8A AE             jp neg_hl
1603  A7C7
1604  A7C7              ; HL = a change over this frame -> its rate a frame (at ASSUMED_FPS):
1605  A7C7              ; HL / fs (fsinv).  Preserves IX, IY.
1606  A7C7              per_frame:
1607  A7C7 ED 5B 59 A8          ld de,(fsinv)
1608  A7CB 18 CA                jr mul_88
1609  A7CD
1610  A7CD              ; A = a per-frame amount (0..255), HL -> its fraction byte (kept between
1611  A7CD              ; frames): A = the whole units this frame (amount * fs + the fraction, the
1612  A7CD              ; new fraction kept; amount * fs under 65536).  Preserves IX, IY, BC.
1613  A7CD              fs_amount:
1614  A7CD C5                   push bc
1615  A7CE E5                   push hl
1616  A7CF 47                   ld b,a
1617  A7D0 57                   ld d,a
1618  A7D1 3A 51 A8             ld a,(fs)
1619  A7D4 5F                   ld e,a
1620  A7D5 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = amount * fraction of fs
1621  A7D7 3A 52 A8             ld a,(fs+1)
1622  A7DA 4F                   ld c,a
1623  A7DB 7A                   ld a,d
1624  A7DC 0D           .w:     dec c                           ; + amount * whole frames of fs
1625  A7DD FA E3 A7             jp m,.d
1626  A7E0 80                   add a,b
1627  A7E1 18 F9                jr .w
1628  A7E3 57           .d:     ld d,a                          ; DE = amount * fs, 8.8
1629  A7E4 E1                   pop hl
1630  A7E5 7E                   ld a,(hl)
1631  A7E6 83                   add a,e
1632  A7E7 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; the fraction kept
1633  A7E8 7A                   ld a,d
1634  A7E9 CE 00                adc a,0                         ; the whole units
1635  A7EB C1                   pop bc
1636  A7EC C9                   ret
1637  A7ED
1638  A7ED              ; fs for dt = 0..DT_MAX ticks: dt * ASSUMED_FPS / TICK_HZ frames, 8.8;
1639  A7ED              ; and its reciprocal (0 for dt 0)
1640  A7ED              fs_tab:
1641  A7ED              FS_I    DEFL 0
1642  A7ED                      DUP DT_MAX+1
1643  A7ED 00 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7EF             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7EF 48 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7F1             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7F1 8F 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7F3             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7F3 D7 00       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7F5             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7F5 1F 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7F7             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7F7 66 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7F9             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7F9 AE 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7FB             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7FB F6 01       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7FD             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1643  A7FD 3D 02       >        dw (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS*256 + TICK_HZ/2) / TICK_HZ
1644  A7FF             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1645  A7FF                      EDUP
1646  A7FF              fsinv_tab:
1647  A7FF 00 00                dw 0
1648  A801              FS_I    DEFL 1
1649  A801                      DUP DT_MAX
1650  A801 92 03       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A803             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A803 C9 01       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A805             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A805 31 01       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A807             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A807 E5 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A809             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A809 B7 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A80B             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A80B 98 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A80D             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A80D 83 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A80F             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1650  A80F 72 00       >        dw (TICK_HZ*256 + FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS/2) / (FS_I*ASSUMED_FPS)
1651  A811             >FS_I    DEFL FS_I+1
1652  A811                      EDUP
1653  A811                      ASSERT TICK_HZ*256/ASSUMED_FPS < 8*256  ; (mul_88: under 8.0)

1848  A943              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
1849  A943              ; Paused (main_loop: the pause control, K_PAUSE, BREAK or a Mega Drive pad's
1850  A943              ; START by default): PAUSED over the view, white on an opaque black ULA box,
1851  A943              ; and under it S: SAVE AND QUIT and X: QUIT, NO SAVE, until the pause control
1852  A943              ; is pressed again.  Nothing moves meanwhile and the screen keeps its last
1853  A943              ; frame.  S (fixed: only while paused) saves the game (save_game) and goes
1854  A943              ; back to the main menu; if it can't be saved, SAVE FAILED, and it stays
1855  A943              ; paused.  (Not in a wreck: nothing to save.)  X (fixed too) goes back to
1856  A943              ; the main menu without saving: the game is lost, and any save game is left
1857  A943              ; as it was.  Needs the input page in slot 7.

1933  AA2B              ; Debug, key 9 (debug_killall, weapons.asm): pick a level.  LEVEL SELECT nn

1935  AA2B              ; Q up, A down (fixed keys; held, they repeat), 1 to LEVEL_LAST.  SPACE goes

2061  AB63              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2062  AB63              ; Save games: ZPDATA/SAVEGAME.ZPS (beside the level files), one game.  Written
2063  AB63              ; by save and quit (game_pause: save_game), read by CONTINUE on the main menu
2064  AB63              ; (load_save, continue_game).  "ZPSV", SG_VERSION, then the fields in
2065  AB63              ; sg_fields, in order: the level and wave, the salvage, the VTOL's integrity
2066  AB63              ; (vtol_hp), its weapon slots (type and ammo each) and the selected one, the
2067  AB63              ; store (wpn_stock, wpn_unlocked), the booster (fitted, fuel), and the
2068  AB63              ; vision modes (vision_owned), and the vertical and lateral thrusters
2069  AB63              ; (vthrust_fitted, lthrust_fitted).  Files of an older version (1: before
2070  AB63              ; the vision modes, 2: before the vertical thrusters, 3: before the lateral
2071  AB63              ; ones, 4: before the linked chain guns, a longer store) are refused, as any
2072  AB63              ; other version.
2073  AB63              ; Continued, the level starts afresh at the saved wave: its zombies, the
2074  AB63              ; humans (and this level's rescues so far) and the base are new.
2075  AB63              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2076  AB63              SG_VERSION      equ 5
2077  AB63              sg_fields:      ; address, bytes
2078  AB63 E9 AE                dw level
2079  AB65 01                   db 1
2080  AB66 F2 AE                dw wave_number
2081  AB68 01                   db 1
2082  AB69 F4 AE                dw salvage_points
2083  AB6B 02                   db 2
2084  AB6C EC AE                dw vtol_hp
2085  AB6E 01                   db 1
2086  AB6F DC AE                dw wpn_slots
2087  AB71 0A                   db WPN_SLOTS*2
2088  AB72 E6 AE                dw wpn_sel
2089  AB74 01                   db 1
2090  AB75 64 AF                dw wpn_stock
2091  AB77 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
2092  AB78 6F AF                dw wpn_unlocked
2093  AB7A 0B                   db WPN_LAST+1
2094  AB7B 7F AF                dw boost_fitted                 ; (and boost_fuel, after it)
2095  AB7D 02                   db 2
2096  AB7E 7A AF                dw vision_owned
2097  AB80 01                   db 1
2098  AB81 7B AF                dw vthrust_fitted
2099  AB83 01                   db 1
2100  AB84 7C AF                dw lthrust_fitted
2101  AB86 01                   db 1
2102  AB87 00 00                dw 0                            ; (the end)
2103  AB89                      ASSERT boost_fuel == boost_fitted+1
2104  AB89              SG_SIZE         equ 5+1+1+2+1+WPN_SLOTS*2+1+2*(WPN_LAST+1)+2+1+1+1
2105  AB89
2106  AB89              ; Copy the fields: A = 0 the game's into sg_buf, 1 sg_buf's into the game

2492  AE96
2493  AE96              ; fmul: HL = HL * DE >> 8
2494  AE96              ;   HL = signed 16-bit integer, DE = S7.8 factor in -1.0..+1.0
2495  AE96              ;   Sign/magnitude using two 8x8 MUL D,E.  Preserves IX, IY.
2496  AE96              fmul:

2498  AE97 AA                   xor d
2499  AE98 F5                   push af                         ; result sign in bit 7
2500  AE99 CB 7C                bit 7,h
2501  AE9B 28 06                jr z,.ap

  62+ E100              ; borrowed (it points into the span), so an interrupt pushes its return

 173+ E883              ; IX = (HL << 16) / DE   with HL < DE (unsigned) -> 0.16 fraction
 174+ E883              ; Restoring division, unrolled: each quotient bit goes in inverted, as the

 248+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 249+ E937              ; Perspective projection
 250+ E937              ;   in : HL -> X,Y,Z (camera space, inside the view frustum, Z > 0)
 251+ E937              ;   out: A = screen x (0..255), C = screen y (0..VIEW_H-1)
 252+ E937              ;   sx = 128 + 128*X/Z,  sy = 64 - 128*Y/Z   (90 x 53 degree field of view)
 253+ E937              ;   Z is normalised to 9 bits (256..511) with a barrel shift (count from a
 254+ E937              ;   log2 table) that is also applied to X and Y, which are then multiplied
 255+ E937              ;   by a 16-bit reciprocal from rtab.  |X| <= Z keeps Xn within 9 bits.
 256+ E937              ;==============================================================================
 257+ E937              project:
 258+ E937 4E                   ld c,(hl)
 259+ E938 23                   inc hl
 260+ E939 46                   ld b,(hl)
 261+ E93A 23                   inc hl                          ; BC = X

 263+ E93C 23                   inc hl

 265+ E93E 23                   inc hl                          ; DE = Y

 322+ E988              ; HL = Z (camera space): normalise it and patch its shift and reciprocal
 323+ E988              ; into scale_comp, which then gives A = |component| * 128 / Z
 324+ E988              zpatch:

 326+ E98A 20 03                jr nz,.z1

 341+ E9A2 18 16                jr .nrm

 353+ E9B5 ED 28                bsla de,b

 357+ E9BB 32 F2 EB             ld (scale_comp.sh+1),a          ; scale_comp's immediates: the shift's

 369+ E9D4
 370+ E9D4                  IFDEF CLIP_2D
 371+ E9D4              ;==============================================================================
 372+ E9D4              ; 2D clip of the current face (df_ptr, df_mask), no corner behind the near
 373+ E9D4              ; plane.  Carry set: a corner is outside the guard band (nothing drawn, clip
 374+ E9D4              ; it in 3D).  Else p2buf / p2n hold the clipped polygon (p2n < 3: none).
 375+ E9D4              ; The corners go into clipA as x, y (16-bit screen), pad, edge flag (+6),
 376+ E9D4              ; pad, and are clipped by clip_poly with clip_plane = $80: plane_dist and
 377+ E9D4              ; clip_isect then work on the 2D plane c2_off / c2_hi, one of x >= 0,
 378+ E9D4              ; x <= 255, y >= 0, y <= VIEW_H-1, and only those some corner is outside.

 485+ EA99              ; IX -> corner (X, Y, Z; Z >= NEAR) -> its screen x, y (16-bit) at IY+0, +2,
 486+ EA99              ; the screen planes it is outside ORed into c2_or.  Carry set (nothing
 487+ EA99              ; stored) if outside the guard band |X| <= 2Z, |Y| <= Z.
 488+ EA99              guard_proj:
 489+ EA99 DD 6E 04             ld l,(ix+4)
 490+ EA9C DD 66 05             ld h,(ix+5)

 492+ EAA0 DD 6E 00             ld l,(ix+0)

 497+ EAAB E5                   push hl

 499+ EAAD 38 04                jr c,.g1

 501+ EAB1 38 45                jr c,.out
 502+ EAB3 DD 6E 02     .g1:    ld l,(ix+2)
 503+ EAB6 DD 66 03             ld h,(ix+3)

 528+ EAF3 FD 74 03             ld (iy+3),h

 533+ EAFA C9                   ret
 534+ EAFB
 535+ EAFB              ; HL = component, DE = the screen centre, B = the upper bound, C = the lower
 536+ EAFB              ; plane's c2_or bit (the upper's is the next) -> HL = DE + 128 HL / Z (the
 537+ EAFB              ; Z patched in by zpatch), and the plane it is outside, if any, into c2_or
 538+ EAFB              c2_scr:

 540+ EAFC D5                   push de

 542+ EAFE F5                   push af
 543+ EAFF CD 20 EB             call scomp16
 544+ EB02 F1                   pop af

 546+ EB04 DC 8A AE             call c,neg_hl

 548+ EB08 19                   add hl,de
 549+ EB09 C1                   pop bc

 563+ EB20
 564+ EB20              ; HL = signed component -> HL = round(|HL| * 128 / Z), |HL| <= 2Z: as
 565+ EB20              ; scale_comp (the same shift and reciprocal, patched into it by zpatch),
 566+ EB20              ; with a 10-bit Xn and a 16-bit result
 567+ EB20              scomp16:
 568+ EB20 CD 91 AE             call abs_hl
 569+ EB23 EB                   ex de,hl
 570+ EB24 3A F2 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.sh+1)          ; the shift zpatch set: its count,
 571+ EB27 47                   ld b,a
 572+ EB28 3A F4 EB             ld a,(scale_comp.op+1)          ; and which way (its opcode)
 573+ EB2B FE 28                cp OP_BSLA
 574+ EB2D 28 04                jr z,.l
 575+ EB2F ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 576+ EB31 18 02                jr .s
 577+ EB33 ED 28        .l:     bsla de,b
 578+ EB35 EB           .s:     ex de,hl
 579+ EB36 7C                   ld a,h
 580+ EB37 FE 04                cp 4
 581+ EB39 38 03                jr c,.ok
 582+ EB3B 21 FF 03             ld hl,1023                      ; (rounding at the guard band's edge)
 583+ EB3E 44           .ok:    ld b,h                          ; bits 8-9 of Xn
 584+ EB3F 3A FE EB             ld a,(scale_comp.rl+1)
 585+ EB42 5F                   ld e,a
 586+ EB43 55                   ld d,l
 587+ EB44 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rl
 588+ EB46 4A                   ld c,d
 589+ EB47 3A 04 EC             ld a,(scale_comp.rh+1)
 590+ EB4A 5F                   ld e,a
 591+ EB4B 55                   ld d,l
 592+ EB4C ED 30                mul d,e                         ; Xl*Rh
 593+ EB4E 79                   ld a,c
 594+ EB4F 83                   add a,e
 595+ EB50 6F                   ld l,a
 596+ EB51 7A                   ld a,d
 597+ EB52 CE 00                adc a,0
 598+ EB54 67                   ld h,a                          ; HL = (Xl*R) >> 8
 599+ EB55 0E 00                ld c,0
 600+ EB57 78                   ld a,b
 601+ EB58 B7                   or a
 602+ EB59 28 0A                jr z,.nh
