   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - input: keyboard and joysticks (8K page PAGE_INPUT, runs at
   3+ E000              ; $E000 in slot 7: main_loop and the menu page it in, and the game logic
   4+ E000              ; pages in slot 6 call it)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; Redefinable controls.  An input (a key, or a joystick direction or button)
   7+ E000              ; is a 16-bit code: high byte = input bank, low byte = bit mask within it.
   8+ E000              ;   banks 0-7: the ZX Spectrum keyboard half-rows (port $xxFE, address line
   9+ E000              ;              A8+bank low): read 0 = pressed
  10+ E000              ;   bank 8:    NextReg $B0, Extended Keys 0: read 1 = pressed
  11+ E000              ;   bank 9:    NextReg $B1, Extended Keys 1: read 1 = pressed
  12+ E000              ;   bank 10:   port $1F, Kempston 1 / Mega Drive 1 (J1_*): read 1 = pressed
  13+ E000              ;   bank 11:   port $37, Kempston 2 / Mega Drive 2 (J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  14+ E000              ;   bank 12:   NextReg $B2, the 6-button Mega Drive pads' X, Y, Z and MODE
  15+ E000              ;              (left connector J1_*, right J2_*): read 1 = pressed
  16+ E000              ; A joystick bank is read only while a joystick is set (NextReg $05, the
  17+ E000              ; Next's joystick modes) to the port it reads, else it is 0: so an unused
  18+ E000              ; port can't read as everything pressed.  Joysticks in Sinclair or Cursor
  19+ E000              ; mode enter keys (6-0, 1-5, 5-8) and are read as keys.
  20+ E000              ; kbd_scan, once per frame at the top of the main loop, reads all the banks
  21+ E000              ; into key_now, inverting the ZX rows so that every bank holds 1 = pressed,
  22+ E000              ; and keeps the previous scan in key_prev.  The game asks about actions
  23+ E000              ; (K_FIRE, K_LEFT, ...), not inputs: each action has a key (key_defs) and a
  24+ E000              ; joystick input (joy_defs; 0 = none), either of which works, so both can
  25+ E000              ; be redefined (key_define) at any time.
  26+ E000              ;   key_held    A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input is down
  27+ E000              ;   key_pressed A = action -> NZ if its key or joystick input went down
  28+ E000              ;               since the last scan
  29+ E000              ;   key_find    -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (for a
  30+ E000              ;               redefine screen); Z if none
  31+ E000              ;   key_code_pressed  HL = key code -> NZ if that key went down
  32+ E000              ; The Next normally also enters the extended keys into the 8x5 matrix (e.g.
  33+ E000              ; cursor LEFT as CAPS SHIFT + 5).  NextReg $68 bit 4 stops that: set it with
  34+ E000              ; kbd_double_on (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE), clear it with kbd_double_off
  35+ E000              ; (FALSE, the default).
  36+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  37+ E000
  38+ E000              ; --- key codes: bank << 8 | mask ---------------------------------------------
  39+ E000              KB_SHIFT    equ $0001                   ; bank 0: $FEFE
  40+ E000              KB_Z        equ $0002
  41+ E000              KB_X        equ $0004
  42+ E000              KB_C        equ $0008
  43+ E000              KB_V        equ $0010
  44+ E000              KB_A        equ $0101                   ; bank 1: $FDFE
  45+ E000              KB_S        equ $0102
  46+ E000              KB_D        equ $0104
  47+ E000              KB_F        equ $0108
  48+ E000              KB_G        equ $0110
  49+ E000              KB_Q        equ $0201                   ; bank 2: $FBFE
  50+ E000              KB_W        equ $0202
  51+ E000              KB_E        equ $0204
  52+ E000              KB_R        equ $0208
  53+ E000              KB_T        equ $0210
  54+ E000              KB_1        equ $0301                   ; bank 3: $F7FE
  55+ E000              KB_2        equ $0302
  56+ E000              KB_3        equ $0304
  57+ E000              KB_4        equ $0308
  58+ E000              KB_5        equ $0310
  59+ E000              KB_0        equ $0401                   ; bank 4: $EFFE
  60+ E000              KB_9        equ $0402
  61+ E000              KB_8        equ $0404
  62+ E000              KB_7        equ $0408
  63+ E000              KB_6        equ $0410
  64+ E000              KB_P        equ $0501                   ; bank 5: $DFFE
  65+ E000              KB_O        equ $0502
  66+ E000              KB_I        equ $0504
  67+ E000              KB_U        equ $0508
  68+ E000              KB_Y        equ $0510
  69+ E000              KB_ENTER    equ $0601                   ; bank 6: $BFFE
  70+ E000              KB_L        equ $0602
  71+ E000              KB_K        equ $0604
  72+ E000              KB_J        equ $0608
  73+ E000              KB_H        equ $0610
  74+ E000              KB_SPACE    equ $0701                   ; bank 7: $7FFE
  75+ E000              KB_SYM      equ $0702
  76+ E000              KB_M        equ $0704
  77+ E000              KB_N        equ $0708
  78+ E000              KB_B        equ $0710
  79+ E000              KB_RIGHT    equ $0801                   ; bank 8: NextReg $B0
  80+ E000              KB_LEFT     equ $0802
  81+ E000              KB_DOWN     equ $0804
  82+ E000              KB_UP       equ $0808
  83+ E000              KB_PERIOD   equ $0810
  84+ E000              KB_COMMA    equ $0820
  85+ E000              KB_QUOTE    equ $0840
  86+ E000              KB_SEMI     equ $0880
  87+ E000              KB_EXTEND   equ $0901                   ; bank 9: NextReg $B1
  88+ E000              KB_CAPSLOCK equ $0902
  89+ E000              KB_GRAPH    equ $0904
  90+ E000              KB_TRUEVID  equ $0908
  91+ E000              KB_INVVID   equ $0910
  92+ E000              KB_BREAK    equ $0920
  93+ E000              KB_EDIT     equ $0940
  94+ E000              KB_DELETE   equ $0980
  95+ E000              JOY_BANK    equ 10                      ; the first joystick bank
  96+ E000              J1_RIGHT    equ $0A01                   ; bank 10: port $1F (Kempston 1 /
  97+ E000              J1_LEFT     equ $0A02                   ;   Mega Drive 1)
  98+ E000              J1_DOWN     equ $0A04
  99+ E000              J1_UP       equ $0A08
 100+ E000              J1_FIRE     equ $0A10                   ; (Mega Drive: B)
 101+ E000              J1_C        equ $0A20                   ; Mega Drive C, A, START
 102+ E000              J1_A        equ $0A40
 103+ E000              J1_START    equ $0A80
 104+ E000              J2_RIGHT    equ $0B01                   ; bank 11: port $37 (Kempston 2 /
 105+ E000              J2_LEFT     equ $0B02                   ;   Mega Drive 2)
 106+ E000              J2_DOWN     equ $0B04
 107+ E000              J2_UP       equ $0B08
 108+ E000              J2_FIRE     equ $0B10
 109+ E000              J2_C        equ $0B20
 110+ E000              J2_A        equ $0B40
 111+ E000              J2_START    equ $0B80
 112+ E000              J1_MODE     equ $0C01                   ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, 6-button
 113+ E000              J1_Y        equ $0C02                   ;   pads (left connector)
 114+ E000              J1_Z        equ $0C04
 115+ E000              J1_X        equ $0C08
 116+ E000              J2_MODE     equ $0C10                   ;   (right connector)
 117+ E000              J2_Y        equ $0C20
 118+ E000              J2_Z        equ $0C40
 119+ E000              J2_X        equ $0C80
 120+ E000              KEY_BANKS   equ 13
 121+ E000              JP_1F_B     equ 0                       ; joystick ports in use (joy_ports):
 122+ E000              JP_37_B     equ 1                       ;   $1F, $37, the 6-button extras
 123+ E000              JP_MD_B     equ 2
 124+ E000              FALSE       equ 0
 125+ E000              TRUE        equ 1
 126+ E000
 127+ E000              ; --- actions: index into key_defs --------------------------------------------
 128+ E000              K_SPEED_UP  equ 0
 129+ E000              K_SPEED_DN  equ 1
 130+ E000              K_AIRBRAKE  equ 2                       ; air brake: rapid stop
 131+ E000              K_LEFT      equ 3
 132+ E000              K_RIGHT     equ 4
 133+ E000              K_CLIMB     equ 5
 134+ E000              K_DESCEND   equ 6
 135+ E000              K_NOSE_UP   equ 7
 136+ E000              K_NOSE_DN   equ 8
 137+ E000              K_FIRE      equ 9
 138+ E000              K_GUN_UP    equ 10                      ; tilt the centre gun up,
 139+ E000              K_SLOT1     equ 11                      ; select weapon slots 1-5
 140+ E000              K_GUN_DN    equ 16                      ; down,
 141+ E000              K_GUN_CTR   equ 17                      ; and back to the centre
 142+ E000              K_PAUSE     equ 18                      ; pause / resume (main_loop)
 143+ E000              K_BOOST     equ 19                      ; the booster on / off (player.asm)
 144+ E000              K_VISION    equ 20                      ; the next vision mode (vis_cycle)
 145+ E000              K_STRAFE_L  equ 21                      ; a lateral thrusters pulse left,
 146+ E000              K_STRAFE_R  equ 22                      ;   right (player.asm strafe)
 147+ E000              K_TARGET    equ 23                      ; the missile lock's next target
 148+ E000                                                      ;   (weapons.asm lk_next)
 149+ E000              K_ACTIONS   equ 24
 150+ E000
 151+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 152+ E000              ; Read all the input banks: key_prev = last scan, key_now = this one, every
 153+ E000              ; bit 1 = pressed
 154+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 155+ E000              kbd_scan:
 156+ E000 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 157+ E003 11 63 E1             ld de,key_prev
 158+ E006 01 0D 00             ld bc,KEY_BANKS
 159+ E009 ED B0                ldir
 160+ E00B 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 161+ E00E 01 FE FE             ld bc,$FEFE                     ; banks 0-7: half-rows $FE..$7F
 162+ E011 ED 78        .row:   in a,(c)
 163+ E013 2F                   cpl                             ; 0 = pressed -> 1 = pressed
 164+ E014 E6 1F                and %00011111
 165+ E016 77                   ld (hl),a
 166+ E017 23                   inc hl
 167+ E018 CB 00                rlc b                           ; next half-row
 168+ E01A 38 F5                jr c,.row                       ; (stops after $7F)
 169+ E01C 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B                     ; banks 8, 9: NextRegs $B0, $B1
 170+ E01F 3E B0                ld a,$B0
 171+ E021 ED 79                out (c),a
 172+ E023 04                   inc b
 173+ E024 ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; already 1 = pressed
 174+ E026 77                   ld (hl),a
 175+ E027 23                   inc hl
 176+ E028 05                   dec b
 177+ E029 3E B1                ld a,$B1
 178+ E02B ED 79                out (c),a
 179+ E02D 04                   inc b
 180+ E02E ED 78                in a,(c)
 181+ E030 77                   ld (hl),a
 182+ E031 23                   inc hl
 183+ E032                      ; banks 10-12, the joysticks: only the ports a joystick is set to
 184+ E032                      ; (NextReg $05), so an unused port can't read as all pressed
 185+ E032 05                   dec b                           ; (BC = $243B)
 186+ E033 3E 05                ld a,$05
 187+ E035 ED 79                out (c),a
 188+ E037 04                   inc b
 189+ E038 ED 58                in e,(c)                        ; the joystick modes
 190+ E03A 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 1: bits 7-6, and bit 3
 191+ E03B 07                   rlca
 192+ E03C 07                   rlca
 193+ E03D E6 03                and 3
 194+ E03F CB 5B                bit 3,e
 195+ E041 28 02                jr z,.j1
 196+ E043 F6 04                or 4
 197+ E045 CD 84 E0     .j1:    call joy_ports
 198+ E048 57                   ld d,a                          ; D: the ports in use (JP_*)
 199+ E049 7B                   ld a,e                          ; joystick 2: bits 5-4, and bit 1
 200+ E04A 0F                   rrca
 201+ E04B 0F                   rrca
 202+ E04C 0F                   rrca
 203+ E04D 0F                   rrca
 204+ E04E E6 03                and 3
 205+ E050 CB 4B                bit 1,e
 206+ E052 28 02                jr z,.j2
 207+ E054 F6 04                or 4
 208+ E056 CD 84 E0     .j2:    call joy_ports
 209+ E059 B2                   or d
 210+ E05A 57                   ld d,a
 211+ E05B AF                   xor a                           ; bank 10: port $1F
 212+ E05C CB 42                bit JP_1F_B,d
 213+ E05E 28 05                jr z,.p1
 214+ E060 DB 1F                in a,($1F)
 215+ E062 CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 216+ E065 77           .p1:    ld (hl),a
 217+ E066 23                   inc hl
 218+ E067 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 11: port $37
 219+ E068 CB 4A                bit JP_37_B,d
 220+ E06A 28 05                jr z,.p2
 221+ E06C DB 37                in a,($37)
 222+ E06E CD 95 E0             call joy_sane
 223+ E071 77           .p2:    ld (hl),a
 224+ E072 23                   inc hl
 225+ E073 AF                   xor a                           ; bank 12: NextReg $B2, the 6-button
 226+ E074 CB 52                bit JP_MD_B,d                   ; pads' extra buttons
 227+ E076 28 0A                jr z,.p3
 228+ E078 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 229+ E07B 3E B2                ld a,$B2
 230+ E07D ED 79                out (c),a
 231+ E07F 04                   inc b
 232+ E080 ED 78                in a,(c)
 233+ E082 77           .p3:    ld (hl),a
 234+ E083 C9                   ret
 235+ E084                      ASSERT KEY_BANKS == 13 && JOY_BANK == 10
 236+ E084
 237+ E084              ; A = a joystick mode (NextReg $05: 0 Sinclair 2, 1 Kempston 1, 2 Cursor,
 238+ E084              ; 3 Sinclair 1, 4 Kempston 2, 5 Mega Drive 1, 6 Mega Drive 2, 7 I/O) -> A =
 239+ E084              ; the ports it is read through (JP_* bits).  Keeps DE, HL.
 240+ E084              joy_ports:
 241+ E084 E5                   push hl
 242+ E085 21 8D E0             ld hl,joy_mode_ports
 243+ E088 ED 31                add hl,a
 244+ E08A 7E                   ld a,(hl)
 245+ E08B E1                   pop hl
 246+ E08C C9                   ret
 247+ E08D
 248+ E08D              joy_mode_ports:
 249+ E08D 00 01 00 00          db 0, 1<<JP_1F_B, 0, 0, 1<<JP_37_B
 249+ E091 02
 250+ E092 05 06 00             db 1<<JP_1F_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 1<<JP_37_B | 1<<JP_MD_B, 0
 251+ E095
 252+ E095              ; A = a Kempston / Mega Drive port read -> A, or 0 if it reads left and
 253+ E095              ; right at once (no stick can: nothing there).  Uses C.
 254+ E095              joy_sane:
 255+ E095 4F                   ld c,a
 256+ E096 E6 03                and %00000011
 257+ E098 FE 03                cp %00000011
 258+ E09A 79                   ld a,c
 259+ E09B C0                   ret nz
 260+ E09C AF                   xor a
 261+ E09D C9                   ret
 262+ E09E
 263+ E09E              ; Stop the extended keys also appearing in the 8x5 matrix:
 264+ E09E              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = TRUE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 1
 265+ E09E              kbd_double_on:
 266+ E09E 3E 01                ld a,TRUE
 267+ E0A0 18 01                jr kbd_double
 268+ E0A2
 269+ E0A2              ; Let the extended keys also appear in the 8x5 matrix (the default):
 270+ E0A2              ; KBD_STOP_DOUBLING = FALSE, NextReg $68 bit 4 = 0
 271+ E0A2              kbd_double_off:
 272+ E0A2              kdb_double_off:                         ; (alias: the name as first asked for)
 273+ E0A2 AF                   xor a                           ; FALSE
 274+ E0A3
 275+ E0A3              ; A = TRUE / FALSE: store it, and set NextReg $68 bit 4 to match, keeping
 276+ E0A3              ; the register's other bits
 277+ E0A3              kbd_double:
 278+ E0A3 32 55 E1             ld (KBD_STOP_DOUBLING),a
 279+ E0A6 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 280+ E0A9 3E 68                ld a,$68
 281+ E0AB ED 79                out (c),a
 282+ E0AD 04                   inc b
 283+ E0AE ED 78                in a,(c)                        ; current NextReg $68
 284+ E0B0 CB A7                res 4,a
 285+ E0B2 21 55 E1             ld hl,KBD_STOP_DOUBLING
 286+ E0B5 CB 46                bit 0,(hl)
 287+ E0B7 28 02                jr z,.w
 288+ E0B9 CB E7                set 4,a
 289+ E0BB ED 79        .w:     out (c),a                       ; ($253B: still selects $68)
 290+ E0BD C9                   ret
 291+ E0BE
 292+ E0BE              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down.  Preserves BC,
 293+ E0BE              ; DE, HL.
 294+ E0BE              key_held:
 295+ E0BE E5                   push hl
 296+ E0BF C5                   push bc
 297+ E0C0 4F                   ld c,a
 298+ E0C1 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 299+ E0C4 A6                   and (hl)
 300+ E0C5 20 05                jr nz,.x
 301+ E0C7 79                   ld a,c
 302+ E0C8 CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 303+ E0CB A6                   and (hl)
 304+ E0CC C1           .x:     pop bc
 305+ E0CD E1                   pop hl
 306+ E0CE C9                   ret
 307+ E0CF
 308+ E0CF              ; A = action -> NZ if its key or its joystick input is down now but wasn't
 309+ E0CF              ; at the last scan.  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 310+ E0CF              key_pressed:
 311+ E0CF E5                   push hl
 312+ E0D0 C5                   push bc
 313+ E0D1 47                   ld b,a
 314+ E0D2 CD 09 E1             call key_def
 315+ E0D5 CD E4 E0             call def_new
 316+ E0D8 20 07                jr nz,.x
 317+ E0DA 78                   ld a,b
 318+ E0DB CD 1A E1             call joy_def
 319+ E0DE CD E4 E0             call def_new
 320+ E0E1 C1           .x:     pop bc
 321+ E0E2 E1                   pop hl
 322+ E0E3 C9                   ret
 323+ E0E4
 324+ E0E4              ; HL -> key_now[bank], A = mask -> NZ if down now but not at the last scan
 325+ E0E4              ; (a mask of 0, no input: never).  Uses C.
 326+ E0E4              def_new:
 327+ E0E4 4F                   ld c,a
 328+ E0E5 A6                   and (hl)
 329+ E0E6 C8                   ret z                           ; not down
 330+ E0E7 79                   ld a,c
 331+ E0E8 D5                   push de
 332+ E0E9 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 333+ E0EC 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 334+ E0ED A6                   and (hl)
 335+ E0EE D1                   pop de
 336+ E0EF A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 337+ E0F0 C9                   ret
 338+ E0F1
 339+ E0F1              ; HL = a key code (KB_...) -> NZ if that key went down since the last scan
 340+ E0F1              ; (for fixed keys, such as the menu's).  Preserves BC, DE, HL.
 341+ E0F1              key_code_pressed:
 342+ E0F1 E5                   push hl
 343+ E0F2 C5                   push bc
 344+ E0F3 4D                   ld c,l                          ; mask
 345+ E0F4 7C                   ld a,h                          ; bank
 346+ E0F5 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 347+ E0F8 ED 31                add hl,a
 348+ E0FA 79                   ld a,c
 349+ E0FB A6                   and (hl)
 350+ E0FC 28 08                jr z,.x                         ; not down
 351+ E0FE D5                   push de
 352+ E0FF 11 0D 00             ld de,KEY_BANKS
 353+ E102 19                   add hl,de                       ; key_prev, same bank
 354+ E103 A6                   and (hl)
 355+ E104 D1                   pop de
 356+ E105 A9                   xor c                           ; down before: Z; new: NZ
 357+ E106 C1           .x:     pop bc
 358+ E107 E1                   pop hl
 359+ E108 C9                   ret
 360+ E109
 361+ E109              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its key's bank], A = its key's mask
 362+ E109              key_def:
 363+ E109 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 364+ E10C                      ; fall through
 365+ E10C
 366+ E10C              ; HL = key_defs or joy_defs, A = action -> HL -> key_now[the bank], A = mask
 367+ E10C              def_at:
 368+ E10C 87                   add a,a
 369+ E10D ED 31                add hl,a
 370+ E10F 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; mask
 371+ E110 23                   inc hl
 372+ E111 F5                   push af
 373+ E112 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; bank
 374+ E113 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 375+ E116 ED 31                add hl,a
 376+ E118 F1                   pop af
 377+ E119 C9                   ret
 378+ E11A
 379+ E11A              ; A = action -> HL -> key_now[its joystick input's bank], A = its mask (0:
 380+ E11A              ; none)
 381+ E11A              joy_def:
 382+ E11A 21 A0 E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 383+ E11D 18 ED                jr def_at
 384+ E11F
 385+ E11F              ; A = action, HL = an input's code: redefine the action's key, or its
 386+ E11F              ; joystick input if the code is a joystick's (bank JOY_BANK on).  Uses B.
 387+ E11F              key_define:
 388+ E11F EB                   ex de,hl
 389+ E120 87                   add a,a
 390+ E121 21 70 E1             ld hl,key_defs
 391+ E124 47                   ld b,a
 392+ E125 7A                   ld a,d
 393+ E126 FE 0A                cp JOY_BANK
 394+ E128 78                   ld a,b
 395+ E129 38 03                jr c,.k
 396+ E12B 21 A0 E1             ld hl,joy_defs
 397+ E12E ED 31        .k:     add hl,a
 398+ E130 73                   ld (hl),e
 399+ E131 23                   inc hl
 400+ E132 72                   ld (hl),d
 401+ E133 EB                   ex de,hl
 402+ E134 C9                   ret
 403+ E135
 404+ E135              ; -> NZ and HL = code of an input that is down (lowest bank, lowest bit); Z
 405+ E135              ; if none.  For a redefine screen.
 406+ E135              key_find:
 407+ E135 21 56 E1             ld hl,key_now
 408+ E138 0E 00                ld c,0                          ; bank
 409+ E13A 7E           .b:     ld a,(hl)
 410+ E13B B7                   or a
 411+ E13C 20 09                jr nz,.got
 412+ E13E 23                   inc hl
 413+ E13F 0C                   inc c
 414+ E140 79                   ld a,c
 415+ E141 FE 0D                cp KEY_BANKS
 416+ E143 20 F5                jr nz,.b
 417+ E145 AF                   xor a                           ; Z: nothing down
 418+ E146 C9                   ret
 419+ E147 06 01        .got:   ld b,1                          ; lowest bit set
 420+ E149 1F           .m:     rra
 421+ E14A 38 04                jr c,.f
 422+ E14C CB 20                sla b
 423+ E14E 18 F9                jr .m
 424+ E150 61           .f:     ld h,c
 425+ E151 68                   ld l,b
 426+ E152 F6 01                or 1                            ; NZ
 427+ E154 C9                   ret
 428+ E155
 429+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 430+ E155              ; Input data
 431+ E155              ;==============================================================================
 432+ E155              KBD_STOP_DOUBLING:
 433+ E155 00                       db FALSE                    ; TRUE: NextReg $68 bit 4 set, extended
 434+ E156                                                      ; keys kept out of the 8x5 matrix
 435+ E156 00 00 00...  key_now:    ds KEY_BANKS                ; this scan, 1 = pressed
 436+ E163 00 00 00...  key_prev:   ds KEY_BANKS                ; the scan before (must follow key_now)
 437+ E170              ; The key and the joystick input of each action, by K_*: the defaults
 438+ E170              ; (key_defaults, joy_defaults), and the ones in use (key_defs, joy_defs:
 439+ E170              ; redefinable on the redefine keys screen, keydef.asm, which can put the
 440+ E170              ; defaults back).  Each set in that order: key_defs, joy_defs, key_defaults,
 441+ E170              ; joy_defaults, one after another (keydef.asm copies all four as one).
 442+ E170                  MACRO KEY_DEFAULTS
 443+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Q                     ; K_SPEED_UP
 444+ E170 ~                        dw KB_A                     ; K_SPEED_DN
 445+ E170 ~                        dw KB_Z                     ; K_AIRBRAKE
 446+ E170 ~                        dw KB_O                     ; K_LEFT
 447+ E170 ~                        dw KB_P                     ; K_RIGHT
 448+ E170 ~                        dw KB_W                     ; K_CLIMB
 449+ E170 ~                        dw KB_S                     ; K_DESCEND
 450+ E170 ~                        dw KB_E                     ; K_NOSE_UP
 451+ E170 ~                        dw KB_D                     ; K_NOSE_DN
 452+ E170 ~                        dw KB_SPACE                 ; K_FIRE
 453+ E170 ~                        dw KB_R                     ; K_GUN_UP

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - hardware sprites, Layer 3 (8K page PAGE_SPRITES, runs at $E000
   3+ E000              ; in slot 7: page it in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_SPRITES before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; The Next has 128 hardware sprites, each 16x16 pixels from a pattern in the
   6+ E000              ; sprite pattern memory (16K, separate from the Z80's: 64 8-bit patterns of
   7+ E000              ; 256 bytes, one byte per pixel, row by row).  A pattern byte is an index
   8+ E000              ; into the sprite palette; SPR_TRANS ($E3, NextReg $4B) is transparent.  The
   9+ E000              ; sprite palette starts as the identity, so until spr_palette changes it a
  10+ E000              ; pattern byte is simply its RRRGGGBB colour.
  11+ E000              ;
  12+ E000              ; Sprites are drawn above Layer 2 and the ULA (priority S U L) and, with
  13+ E000              ; NextReg $15 bit 1 set, over the border as well, so the sprite screen is
  14+ E000              ; 320 x 256 pixels:
  15+ E000              ;
  16+ E000              ;     x 0..319, y 0..255;  (SPR_SCREEN_X, SPR_SCREEN_Y) = (32, 32) is the top
  17+ E000              ;     left of the 256x192 Layer 2 / ULA screen, (288, 224) its bottom right
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; A sprite's position is its top left pixel.  Coordinates are 9 bits and
  20+ E000              ; wrap round at 512, so they may be negative (two's complement): a sprite at
  21+ E000              ; x = -8 shows its right half at the left edge.  With overlapping sprites,
  22+ E000              ; the higher numbered one is drawn on top.
  23+ E000              ;
  24+ E000              ; Use: sprites_init once (start-up), load patterns with spr_patterns or
  25+ E000              ; from a sprite bank (sprite_data.asm: page the bank into slot 7 and call
  26+ E000              ; its spr_load_bank, from outside slot 7), and a palette with spr_palette
  27+ E000              ; if wanted, then set up sprites in the shadow
  28+ E000              ; table with spr_set / spr_pos / spr_pattern / spr_flags / spr_scale /
  29+ E000              ; spr_hide / spr_show / spr_hide_all, and copy the table to the hardware
  30+ E000              ; once a frame with spr_update.  The table holds the first SPR_COUNT sprites;
  31+ E000              ; the rest stay hidden.
  32+ E000              ;
  33+ E000              ; Attributes, SPR_ATTR (5) bytes a sprite, kept in the table as they are
  34+ E000              ; sent (the 5-byte form):
  35+ E000              ;   +0  x bits 0-7
  36+ E000              ;   +1  y bits 0-7
  37+ E000              ;   +2  bits 7-4 palette offset (added to the pattern byte's top nibble),
  38+ E000              ;       bit 3 x mirror, 2 y mirror, 1 rotate 90 degrees clockwise, 0 x bit 8
  39+ E000              ;   +3  bit 7 visible, bit 6 = 1 (byte +4 follows), bits 5-0 pattern
  40+ E000              ;   +4  bits 4-3 x scale, bits 2-1 y scale (0..3 = x1, x2, x4, x8), 0 y bit 8
  41+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  42+ E000
  43+ E000              SPR_COUNT       equ 42          ; sprites in the shadow table (max 128)
  44+ E000              SPR_HW          equ 128         ; hardware sprites
  45+ E000              SPR_ATTR        equ 5           ; attribute bytes per sprite
  46+ E000              SPR_PATTERNS    equ 64          ; 8-bit 16x16 patterns in pattern memory
  47+ E000              SPR_SIZE        equ 16          ; pixels, each way (at scale x1)
  48+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_X    equ 32          ; sprite coordinates of the 256x192
  49+ E000              SPR_SCREEN_Y    equ 32          ; screen's top left pixel
  50+ E000              SPR_TRANS       equ $E3         ; transparent pattern byte (NextReg $4B)
  51+ E000
  52+ E000              SPRF_PAL        equ $10         ; flags (attribute +2): palette offset x 16,
  53+ E000              SPRF_XMIRROR    equ $08         ; mirror left-right,
  54+ E000              SPRF_YMIRROR    equ $04         ; mirror top-bottom,
  55+ E000              SPRF_ROT        equ $02         ; rotate 90 degrees clockwise
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              SPR_SLOT_PORT   equ $303B       ; write: select sprite / pattern slot
  58+ E000              SPR_ATTR_PORT   equ $57         ; write: attributes, from the selected sprite
  59+ E000              SPR_PAT_PORT    equ $5B         ; write: pattern bytes, from the selected slot
  60+ E000
  61+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  62+ E000              ; Start-up: sprites on, shown over the border too (the full 320 x 256),
  63+ E000              ; priority S U L; the transparent index; every hardware sprite hidden and the shadow table cleared (all hidden,
  64+ E000              ; pattern 0, at 0,0).
  65+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  66+ E000              sprites_init:
  67+ E000 ED 91 15 0B          nextreg $15,%00001011           ; priority S U L, sprites over the
  68+ E004                                                      ; border (bit 1), visible (bit 0)
  69+ E004 ED 91 4B E3          nextreg $4B,SPR_TRANS
  70+ E008 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT             ; from sprite 0, the 4-byte form
  71+ E00B AF                   xor a                           ; (+3 bit 6 clear): all hidden
  72+ E00C ED 79                out (c),a
  73+ E00E 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
  74+ E010 11 00 02             ld de,SPR_HW*4
  75+ E013 ED 79        .hw:    out (c),a
  76+ E015 1B                   dec de
  77+ E016 7A                   ld a,d
  78+ E017 B3                   or e
  79+ E018 3E 00                ld a,0
  80+ E01A 20 F7                jr nz,.hw
  81+ E01C 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
  82+ E01F 06 2A                ld b,SPR_COUNT
  83+ E021 77           .sh:    ld (hl),a                       ; x, y, flags 0
  84+ E022 23                   inc hl
  85+ E023 77                   ld (hl),a
  86+ E024 23                   inc hl
  87+ E025 77                   ld (hl),a
  88+ E026 23                   inc hl
  89+ E027 36 40                ld (hl),$40                     ; hidden, 5-byte form, pattern 0
  90+ E029 23                   inc hl
  91+ E02A 77                   ld (hl),a                       ; scale x1
  92+ E02B 23                   inc hl
  93+ E02C 10 F3                djnz .sh
  94+ E02E                      ; fall through: send it
  95+ E02E
  96+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E02E              ; Copy the shadow table to sprites 0..SPR_COUNT-1.  Once a frame, after the
  98+ E02E              ; changes (best just after the frame flip, so a move doesn't show half done).
  99+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 100+ E02E              spr_update:
 101+ E02E 01 3B 30             ld bc,SPR_SLOT_PORT
 102+ E031 AF                   xor a
 103+ E032 ED 79                out (c),a                       ; from sprite 0
 104+ E034 21 00 E2             ld hl,spr_shadow
 105+ E037 0E 57                ld c,SPR_ATTR_PORT
 106+ E039 16 2A                ld d,SPR_COUNT
 107+ E03B 06 05        .lp:    ld b,SPR_ATTR
 108+ E03D ED B3                otir
 109+ E03F 15                   dec d
 110+ E040 20 F9                jr nz,.lp
 111+ E042 C9                   ret

 113+ E043              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 283+ E108              ; Sprite data
 284+ E108              ;==============================================================================
 285+ E108              ; The patterns themselves are in the sprite banks (sprite_data.asm).
 286+ E108              ; Bank 0 has the human status sprites, loaded as patterns 0-3 by
 287+ E108              ; sprites_init, after the HUD's passenger markers:
 288+ E108              ;   HSPR_FIELD   0  waiting in the field, not yet rescued: an empty square
 289+ E108              ;   HSPR_ABOARD  1  aboard the VTOL: a person sitting in a chair
 290+ E108              ;   HSPR_SAVED   2  rescued: a green person standing
 291+ E108              ;   HSPR_DEAD    3  dead: a white person with a red cross over them

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - start-up initialisation (8K page PAGE_INIT, runs at $E000 in
   3+ E000              ; slot 7)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Code needed only once, at start-up, kept out of the resident page: start
   6+ E000              ; (zpolice.asm) pages this in with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_INIT and calls
   7+ E000              ; initgame, then slot 7 is free for the other core pages.
   8+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E000
  10+ E000              ; Hardware set-up: 28MHz, Layer 2 mode, transparency, layer priority, Layer
  11+ E000              ; 2 scroll and clip window, the memory map of the always-mapped slots, the
  12+ E000              ; peripheral settings (AY sound, turbo sound, internal speaker, no
  13+ E000              ; contention), and a black border.
  14+ E000              initgame:
  15+ E000 ED 91 07 03          nextreg $07,3                   ; 28MHz
  16+ E004 ED 91 70 00          nextreg $70,0                   ; Layer 2 256x192 mode
  17+ E008 ED 91 14 E3          nextreg $14,$E3                 ; global transparency colour
  18+ E00C ED 91 15 08          nextreg $15,%00001000           ; priority S U L (ULA over L2); sprites

# file opened: file_handler.asm
   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - file handling: loading and saving on the SD card (8K page
   3+ E000              ; PAGE_FILE, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in with nextreg
   4+ E000              ; CODE_MMU,PAGE_FILE before calling)
   5+ E000              ;
   6+ E000              ; General-purpose routines over the esxDOS / NextZXOS file API (RST $08 with
   7+ E000              ; a function code after it).  Game-specific loading and saving (save games,
   8+ E000              ; high scores, settings) go on top of these.
   9+ E000              ;
  10+ E000              ; The ROM: the divMMC only traps RST $08 while the ROM is paged in at
  11+ E000              ; $0000-$3FFF, but the game keeps other pages there (slot 0: a Layer 2
  12+ E000              ; section or the sine table; slot 1: the zombie page).  So every call pages
  13+ E000              ; the ROM into slots 0 and 1 (fh_rom_in), makes the RST $08, then puts the
  14+ E000              ; game's pages back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off over the call (the
  15+ E000              ; game's IM 2 routine is in slot 1, covered by the ROM, and IY is in use and
  16+ E000              ; slot 2 holds game data, so the ROM's routine must not run either), and
  17+ E000              ; fh_rom_out turns them back on if they were on.
  18+ E000              ;
  19+ E000              ; Rules for callers:
  20+ E000              ;   * page this in at $E000 (slot 7) first, and call from outside slot 7:
  21+ E000              ;     resident code or a game logic page in slot 6;
  22+ E000              ;   * file names and data buffers must be in $4000-$DFFF: not in slots 0-1
  23+ E000              ;     (the ROM and esxDOS are there during a call) nor slot 7 (this page);
  24+ E000              ;   * file names end with a 0 byte.
  25+ E000              ;
  26+ E000              ; Every routine returns carry clear on success; carry set on failure with
  27+ E000              ; A = the esxDOS error code.  A file that was opened is closed again on
  28+ E000              ; any error in fh_load / fh_save.
  29+ E000              ;
  30+ E000              ; Routines:
  31+ E000              ;   fh_init      get the default drive (call once, before the others)
  32+ E000              ;   fh_open      HL = name, B = mode (FA_*)      -> A = handle
  33+ E000              ;   fh_close     A = handle
  34+ E000              ;   fh_read      A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read
  35+ E000              ;   fh_write     A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
  36+ E000              ;   fh_seek      A = handle, BCDE = offset, L = SEEK_* -> BCDE = position
  37+ E000              ;   fh_size      A = handle                      -> BCDE = file size
  38+ E000              ;   fh_load      HL = name, DE = address, BC = most bytes -> BC = bytes read
  39+ E000              ;   fh_save      HL = name, DE = address, BC = length (created / replaced)
  40+ E000              ;   fh_exists    HL = name -> carry clear if the file exists
  41+ E000              ;   fh_delete    HL = name
  42+ E000              ;   fh_mkdir     HL = name: make the folder (its parent must exist; carry,
  43+ E000              ;                A = the error, if it can't: it's there already, say)
  44+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ E000
  46+ E000              ; esxDOS function codes (the byte after RST $08)
  47+ E000              M_GETSETDRV     equ $89             ; A = 0: get the default drive
  48+ E000              F_OPEN          equ $9A
  49+ E000              F_CLOSE         equ $9B
  50+ E000              F_READ          equ $9D
  51+ E000              F_WRITE         equ $9E
  52+ E000              F_SEEK          equ $9F
  53+ E000              F_FSTAT         equ $A1
  54+ E000              F_UNLINK        equ $AD
  55+ E000              F_MKDIR         equ $AA
  56+ E000
  57+ E000              ; F_OPEN modes (B)
  58+ E000              FA_READ         equ $01             ; read
  59+ E000              FA_WRITE        equ $02             ; write
  60+ E000              FA_OPEN_EX      equ $00             ; open an existing file only
  61+ E000              FA_OPEN_AL      equ $08             ; open, or create if it doesn't exist
  62+ E000              FA_CREATE_NEW   equ $04             ; create, fail if it exists
  63+ E000              FA_CREATE_AL    equ $0C             ; create, replacing any existing file
  64+ E000              FA_OVERWRITE    equ FA_WRITE|FA_CREATE_AL   ; for saving a whole file
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; F_SEEK modes (L)
  67+ E000              SEEK_START      equ 0               ; from the start of the file
  68+ E000              SEEK_FWD        equ 1               ; forwards from the current position
  69+ E000              SEEK_BACK       equ 2               ; backwards from the current position
  70+ E000
  71+ E000              FSTAT_SIZE      equ 7               ; F_FSTAT buffer: file size, 4 bytes
  72+ E000              FSTAT_LEN       equ 11              ; F_FSTAT buffer length
  73+ E000
  74+ E000              ESX_DEFAULT     equ '*'             ; drive: the default drive
  75+ E000
  76+ E000              ; An esxDOS call: the ROM in at $0000-$3FFF for the RST $08, the game's
  77+ E000              ; pages back after.  Registers in and out are the function's own; flags
  78+ E000              ; and A come back from esxDOS (carry set = error, A = code).
  79+ E000                      MACRO ESXDOS fn
  80+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_in
  81+ E000 ~                    rst $08
  82+ E000 ~                    db fn
  83+ E000 ~                    call fh_rom_out
  84+ E000                      ENDM
  85+ E000
  86+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  87+ E000              ; Get the default drive into fh_drive (else the '*' default is used)
  88+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ E000              fh_init:
  90+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; A = 0: get
  91+ E001                      ESXDOS M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E001 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
  91+ E004 CF          >        rst $08
  91+ E005 89          >        db M_GETSETDRV
  91+ E006 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
  92+ E009 D8                   ret c
  93+ E00A 32 29 E1             ld (fh_drive),a
  94+ E00D C9                   ret
  95+ E00E
  96+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  97+ E00E              ; HL -> file name, B = mode (FA_*) -> A = handle (also in fh_handle)
  98+ E00E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  99+ E00E              fh_open:
 100+ E00E DD E5                push ix
 101+ E010 E5                   push hl
 102+ E011 DD E1                pop ix                          ; IX = HL = the name (both
 103+ E013 3A 29 E1             ld a,(fh_drive)                 ; conventions: programs, dot
 104+ E016                      ESXDOS F_OPEN                   ; commands)
 104+ E016 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 104+ E019 CF          >        rst $08
 104+ E01A 9A          >        db F_OPEN
 104+ E01B CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 105+ E01E DD E1                pop ix
 106+ E020 D8                   ret c
 107+ E021 32 2A E1             ld (fh_handle),a
 108+ E024 C9                   ret
 109+ E025
 110+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 111+ E025              ; A = handle: close it
 112+ E025              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 113+ E025              fh_close:

 114+ E028 CF          >        rst $08
 114+ E029 9B          >        db F_CLOSE
 114+ E02A CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 115+ E02D C9                   ret
 116+ E02E
 117+ E02E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 118+ E02E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes read (fewer at the end
 119+ E02E              ; of the file)

 121+ E02E              fh_read:
 122+ E02E DD E5                push ix
 123+ E030 E5                   push hl
 124+ E031 DD E1                pop ix
 125+ E033                      ESXDOS F_READ
 125+ E033 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 125+ E036 CF          >        rst $08
 125+ E037 9D          >        db F_READ
 125+ E038 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 126+ E03B DD E1                pop ix
 127+ E03D C9                   ret
 128+ E03E
 129+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130+ E03E              ; A = handle, HL = address, BC = length -> BC = bytes written
 131+ E03E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 132+ E03E              fh_write:
 133+ E03E DD E5                push ix
 134+ E040 E5                   push hl
 135+ E041 DD E1                pop ix
 136+ E043                      ESXDOS F_WRITE
 136+ E043 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 136+ E046 CF          >        rst $08
 136+ E047 9E          >        db F_WRITE
 136+ E048 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 137+ E04B DD E1                pop ix
 138+ E04D C9                   ret
 139+ E04E
 140+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 141+ E04E              ; A = handle, BCDE = offset (32-bit), L = mode (SEEK_*) -> BCDE = position
 142+ E04E              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 143+ E04E              fh_seek:
 144+ E04E DD E5                push ix
 145+ E050 E5                   push hl
 146+ E051 E5                   push hl
 147+ E052 DD E1                pop ix                          ; mode in IXL (programs) and L
 148+ E054                      ESXDOS F_SEEK
 148+ E054 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 148+ E057 CF          >        rst $08
 148+ E058 9F          >        db F_SEEK
 148+ E059 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 149+ E05C E1                   pop hl
 150+ E05D DD E1                pop ix
 151+ E05F C9                   ret
 152+ E060
 153+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 154+ E060              ; A = handle -> BCDE = file size (32-bit)
 155+ E060              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 156+ E060              fh_size:
 157+ E060 DD E5                push ix
 158+ E062 E5                   push hl
 159+ E063 21 2E E1             ld hl,fh_stat
 160+ E066 E5                   push hl
 161+ E067 DD E1                pop ix
 162+ E069                      ESXDOS F_FSTAT
 162+ E069 CD DF E0    >        call fh_rom_in
 162+ E06C CF          >        rst $08
 162+ E06D A1          >        db F_FSTAT
 162+ E06E CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 163+ E071 38 0A                jr c,.x
 164+ E073 2A 35 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE)
 165+ E076 EB                   ex de,hl                        ; DE = low word
 166+ E077 2A 37 E1             ld hl,(fh_stat+FSTAT_SIZE+2)
 167+ E07A 44                   ld b,h                          ; BC = high word
 168+ E07B 4D                   ld c,l
 169+ E07C B7                   or a
 170+ E07D E1           .x:     pop hl
 171+ E07E DD E1                pop ix
 172+ E080 C9                   ret
 173+ E081
 174+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 175+ E081              ; Load a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = most bytes to read
 176+ E081              ; -> BC = bytes read.  The file is opened, read and closed.
 177+ E081              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 178+ E081              fh_load:
 179+ E081 D5                   push de
 180+ E082 C5                   push bc
 181+ E083 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 182+ E085 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 183+ E088 C1                   pop bc
 184+ E089 E1                   pop hl                          ; HL = address
 185+ E08A D8                   ret c                           ; couldn't open (A = error)
 186+ E08B CD 2E E0             call fh_read
 187+ E08E 18 0D                jr fh_done                      ; close it, keeping any error
 188+ E090
 189+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 190+ E090              ; Save a file: HL -> name, DE = address, BC = length.  The file is created,
 191+ E090              ; replacing any file of that name.
 192+ E090              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 193+ E090              fh_save:
 194+ E090 D5                   push de
 195+ E091 C5                   push bc
 196+ E092 06 0E                ld b,FA_OVERWRITE
 197+ E094 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 198+ E097 C1                   pop bc
 199+ E098 E1                   pop hl
 200+ E099 D8                   ret c
 201+ E09A CD 3E E0             call fh_write
 202+ E09D                      ; fall through
 203+ E09D
 204+ E09D              ; After a read / write on fh_handle: close the file.  Carry and A as from
 205+ E09D              ; that read / write if it failed, else as from the close.
 206+ E09D              fh_done:
 207+ E09D F5                   push af
 208+ E09E 3A 2A E1             ld a,(fh_handle)
 209+ E0A1 CD 25 E0             call fh_close
 210+ E0A4 38 02                jr c,.cerr
 211+ E0A6 F1                   pop af                          ; the read / write's result
 212+ E0A7 C9                   ret
 213+ E0A8 E1           .cerr:  pop hl                          ; the close failed: if the read /
 214+ E0A9 CB 45                bit 0,l                         ; write had already failed, report
 215+ E0AB 28 01                jr z,.ce                        ; that, else the close's error
 216+ E0AD 7C                   ld a,h
 217+ E0AE 37           .ce:    scf
 218+ E0AF C9                   ret
 219+ E0B0
 220+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 221+ E0B0              ; HL -> name: carry clear if the file exists (it can be opened to read)
 222+ E0B0              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 223+ E0B0              fh_exists:
 224+ E0B0 06 01                ld b,FA_READ|FA_OPEN_EX
 225+ E0B2 CD 0E E0             call fh_open
 226+ E0B5 D8                   ret c

 229+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 230+ E0B9              ; HL -> name: delete the file
 231+ E0B9              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 234+ E0BB E5                   push hl
 235+ E0BC DD E1                pop ix

 241+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 242+ E0CC              ; HL -> name: make the folder
 243+ E0CC              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 247+ E0CF DD E1                pop ix

 249+ E0D4                      ESXDOS F_MKDIR

 249+ E0D7 CF          >        rst $08
 249+ E0D8 AA          >        db F_MKDIR
 249+ E0D9 CD 10 E1    >        call fh_rom_out
 250+ E0DC DD E1                pop ix
 251+ E0DE C9                   ret
 252+ E0DF
 253+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 254+ E0DF              ; Page the ROM into slots 0 and 1 for RST $08, remembering the game's pages
 255+ E0DF              ; (fh_rom_in), and put them back (fh_rom_out).  Interrupts are off in
 256+ E0DF              ; between (the ROM covers the interrupt routine, slot 1), and back on after
 257+ E0DF              ; if they were on before.  Both keep every register and flag.
 258+ E0DF              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 259+ E0DF              fh_rom_in:
 260+ E0DF F5                   push af
 261+ E0E0 ED 57                ld a,i                          ; P/V: interrupts on (IFF2)
 262+ E0E2 F3                   di
 263+ E0E3 3E 00                ld a,0
 264+ E0E5 E2 E9 E0             jp po,.off
 265+ E0E8 3C                   inc a
 266+ E0E9 32 2D E1     .off:   ld (fh_ints),a
 267+ E0EC C5                   push bc
 268+ E0ED 01 3B 24             ld bc,$243B
 269+ E0F0 3E 50                ld a,MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER        ; slot 0's page now
 270+ E0F2 ED 79                out (c),a
 271+ E0F4 04                   inc b
 272+ E0F5 ED 78                in a,(c)
 273+ E0F7 32 2B E1             ld (fh_mmu0),a
 274+ E0FA 05                   dec b
 275+ E0FB 3E 51                ld a,MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER        ; slot 1's
 276+ E0FD ED 79                out (c),a
 277+ E0FF 04                   inc b
 278+ E100 ED 78                in a,(c)
 279+ E102 32 2C E1             ld (fh_mmu1),a
 280+ E105 ED 91 50 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 281+ E109 ED 91 51 FF          nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,PAGE_ROM
 282+ E10D C1                   pop bc
 283+ E10E F1                   pop af
 284+ E10F C9                   ret
 285+ E110
 286+ E110              fh_rom_out:
 287+ E110 F3                   di                              ; (in case esxDOS enabled them)
 288+ E111 F5                   push af
 289+ E112 3A 2B E1             ld a,(fh_mmu0)
 290+ E115 ED 92 50             nextreg MMU_SLOT_0_REGISTER,a
 291+ E118 3A 2C E1             ld a,(fh_mmu1)
 292+ E11B ED 92 51             nextreg MMU_SLOT_1_REGISTER,a
 293+ E11E 3A 2D E1             ld a,(fh_ints)
 294+ E121 B7                   or a
 295+ E122 28 03                jr z,.off
 296+ E124 F1                   pop af
 297+ E125 FB                   ei                              ; on again, as they were
 298+ E126 C9                   ret
 299+ E127 F1           .off:   pop af
 300+ E128 C9                   ret
 301+ E129
 302+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 303+ E129              ; File handler data
 304+ E129              ;==============================================================================
 305+ E129 2A           fh_drive:   db ESX_DEFAULT              ; drive for F_OPEN (fh_init)
 306+ E12A 00           fh_handle:  db 0                        ; the last file opened
 307+ E12B 00           fh_mmu0:    db 0                        ; the game's slot 0 / 1 pages during
 308+ E12C 00           fh_mmu1:    db 0                        ; an esxDOS call
 309+ E12D 00           fh_ints:    db 0                        ; 1: interrupts were on before it
 310+ E12E 00 00 00...  fh_stat:    ds FSTAT_LEN                ; F_FSTAT buffer (fh_size)

   1+ E000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E000              ; Z-POLICE - audio (8K page PAGE_AUDIO, runs at $E000 in slot 7: page it in
   3+ E000              ; with nextreg CODE_MMU,PAGE_AUDIO before calling)
   4+ E000              ;
   5+ E000              ; Sound devices: the Next's TurboSound, three AY-3-8912 chips.  initgame
   6+ E000              ; (initialise.asm) has already set the chip mode to AY (NextReg $06),
   7+ E000              ; turned TurboSound and the internal speaker on (NextReg $08), and the
   8+ E000              ; engines' chip, AY 1, to mono (NextReg $09: its three channels in the
   9+ E000              ; centre, AY_MONO_ENGINES), the effects' chips stereo.  init_audio then sets every chip to a
  10+ E000              ; known, silent state (at start-up, and on every menu screen: menu_quiet).
  11+ E000              ; AY 1 is the VTOL's engines: engine_start here, then the interrupt routine
  12+ E000              ; plays them (engine_tick, interrupts.asm).  AY 2 is the weapons' sound
  13+ E000              ; effects, AY 3 explosions: the game asks for one with ld a,SFX_n / ld
  14+ E000              ; (sfx_req),a (AY 2's A and B), ld (sfx2_req),a (AY 3's A and B), ld
  15+ E000              ; (sfx3_req),a (AY 3's C) or ld (sfx4_req),a (AY 2's C: the base's
  16+ E000              ; warnings), and the interrupt plays it (sfx_tick).  (Music would need AY 3
  17+ E000              ; back.)  The interrupt writes the AY ports while eng_on is 1,
  18+ E000              ; so code here writes them only with eng_on 0 (or interrupts off).
  19+ E000              ;
  20+ E000              ; TurboSound ports:
  21+ E000              ;   $FFFD write %1LR111cc: select AY chip cc (AY_CHIP_1..3) with its left
  22+ E000              ;         (L) and right (R) outputs on;
  23+ E000              ;         any value 0..15: select that register of the selected chip
  24+ E000              ;   $BFFD write: the value of the selected register
  25+ E000              ;==============================================================================
  26+ E000
  27+ E000              AY_CTRL_PORT    equ $FFFD           ; chip / register select
  28+ E000              AY_DATA_PORT    equ $BFFD           ; register value
  29+ E000
  30+ E000              ; Chip select ($FFFD): AY_SELECT | AY_LEFT | AY_RIGHT | AY_CHIP_n
  31+ E000              AY_SELECT       equ %10011100       ; bit 7 and bits 4-2 must be set
  32+ E000              AY_LEFT         equ %01000000       ; left output on
  33+ E000              AY_RIGHT        equ %00100000       ; right output on
  34+ E000              AY_CHIP_1       equ %11
  35+ E000              AY_CHIP_2       equ %10
  36+ E000              AY_CHIP_3       equ %01
  37+ E000              ; NextReg $09 (Peripheral 4) bits 5-7 put the hardware's AY 0, 1, 2 in mono:
  38+ E000              ; select %11 is its AY 0, the game's AY 1 (the engines), so bit 5
  39+ E000              AY_MONO_ENGINES equ %00100000
  40+ E000                      ASSERT AY_CHIP_1 == %11
  41+ E000
  42+ E000              ; AY registers
  43+ E000              AY_TONE_A       equ 0               ; channel A tone period: fine, coarse (4)
  44+ E000              AY_TONE_B       equ 2
  45+ E000              AY_TONE_C       equ 4
  46+ E000              AY_NOISE        equ 6               ; noise period (5 bits)
  47+ E000              AY_MIXER        equ 7               ; tone / noise enable, 0 = on:
  48+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_A    equ %00000001       ;   bits 0-2 tone A-C off,
  49+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_B    equ %00000010
  50+ E000              AY_NO_TONE_C    equ %00000100
  51+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_A   equ %00001000       ;   bits 3-5 noise A-C off
  52+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_B   equ %00010000
  53+ E000              AY_NO_NOISE_C   equ %00100000
  54+ E000              AY_VOL_A        equ 8               ; amplitude 0-15 (bit 4: use envelope)
  55+ E000              AY_VOL_B        equ 9
  56+ E000              AY_VOL_C        equ 10
  57+ E000              AY_ENV_FINE     equ 11              ; envelope period
  58+ E000              AY_ENV_COARSE   equ 12
  59+ E000              AY_ENV_SHAPE    equ 13              ; envelope shape
  60+ E000              AY_REGS         equ 14
  61+ E000
  62+ E000              AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD equ %1101        ; envelope: rise once, then hold
  63+ E000              AY_MIXER_INIT   equ AY_NO_NOISE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  64+ E000                                                  ; tones on, noise off
  65+ E000
  66+ E000              ; The engines (AY 1): jet turbines, from n = |speed| (at least 1: the idle,
  67+ E000              ; at zero throttle, sounds as speed 1), 1..SPEED_MAX
  68+ E000              ENG_MIXER       equ AY_NO_TONE_A|AY_NO_NOISE_B|AY_NO_NOISE_C
  69+ E000                                                  ; A noise only, B and C tone only
  70+ E000              ENG_NOISE0      equ 29              ; A, the roar: noise period 29 - n*13/16
  71+ E000              ENG_NOISE_MUL   equ 13              ;   (29 at idle, a rumble; 7 flat out, a hiss)
  72+ E000              ENG_ROAR_VOL0   equ 4               ;   volume 4 + n*7/32 (4..10)

  74+ E000              ENG_WHINE_STEP  equ 3               ;   (~500 Hz at idle, ~790 Hz flat out)

  76+ E000              ENG_VOL_MUL     equ 7               ; the volumes rise by n*7/32 (0..6)
  77+ E000              ENG_DETUNE      equ 2               ; C, the same whine 2 periods lower: the
  78+ E000              ENG_SHIMMER_VOL equ 2               ;   two beat (the turbines' shimmer), 2 quieter
  79+ E000              ; Sound effects (sfx_tick, interrupts.asm): their numbers, and the step codes
  80+ E000              SFX_MG          equ 1               ; the machine gun: one round
  81+ E000              SFX_LASER       equ 2               ; the pulse laser: one pulse (a zap)

  84+ E000              SFX_MISSILE     equ 5               ; a missile fired: a longer woosh

  87+ E000              SFX_BOOM_MISSILE equ 8              ;   a missile's,
  88+ E000              SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON equ 9           ;   an autocannon shell's,

  92+ E000              SFX_LOCK        equ 13              ; the missile lock: a double beep (AY 2)

  97+ E000              SFX_WARN_LOW    equ 16              ; the base's warnings (AY 2 C, sfx4_req):

  99+ E000              SFX_WARN_MID    equ 17              ;   the landing pad hit, a mid one

 116+ E000                      ASSERT AY_REGS < SFX_STEP
 117+ E000
 118+ E000              ENG_FRAC        equ 16              ; the engines' speed (eng_cur) in 1/16 steps:
 119+ E000              ENG_SPIN_UP     equ 4               ;   up by at most 4/16 an interrupt (12.5 steps
 120+ E000              ENG_SPIN_DOWN   equ 2               ;   a second), down by 2/16 (6.25 a second)

 129+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 130+ E000              ; Set up the sound devices: each AY chip selected with both outputs, every
 131+ E000              ; register 0 (silent: all volumes 0), then the mixer to tones only and the
 132+ E000              ; envelope to attack-and-hold.  AY 1 is left selected.
 133+ E000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 134+ E000              init_audio:
 135+ E000 AF                   xor a                           ; the engines off first: the interrupt
 136+ E001 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; leaves the AYs alone (interrupts.asm)
 137+ E004 32 8A 3C             ld (sfx_req),a                  ; and no sound effect asked for or
 138+ E007 32 8D 3C             ld (sfx2_req),a                 ; playing, on any voice
 139+ E00A 32 90 3C             ld (sfx3_req),a
 140+ E00D 32 93 3C             ld (sfx4_req),a
 141+ E010 67                   ld h,a
 142+ E011 6F                   ld l,a
 143+ E012 22 8B 3C             ld (sfx_ptr),hl
 144+ E015 22 8E 3C             ld (sfx2_ptr),hl
 145+ E018 22 91 3C             ld (sfx3_ptr),hl
 146+ E01B 22 94 3C             ld (sfx4_ptr),hl
 147+ E01E 3E 01                ld a,AY_CHIP_3
 148+ E020 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip
 149+ E023 3E 02                ld a,AY_CHIP_2
 150+ E025 CD 2A E0             call ay_init_chip
 151+ E028 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 152+ E02A                      ; fall through
 153+ E02A
 154+ E02A              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it in stereo, clear it, mixer and envelope
 155+ E02A              ay_init_chip:
 156+ E02A CD 63 E0             call ay_select
 157+ E02D 16 0D                ld d,AY_REGS-1                  ; registers 13..0 = 0
 158+ E02F 7A           .clr:   ld a,d
 159+ E030 1E 00                ld e,0
 160+ E032 CD 6B E0             call ay_write

 162+ E036 F2 2F E0             jp p,.clr
 163+ E039 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 164+ E03B 1E 38                ld e,AY_MIXER_INIT
 165+ E03D CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 166+ E040 3E 0D                ld a,AY_ENV_SHAPE
 167+ E042 1E 0D                ld e,AY_ENV_ATTACK_HOLD
 168+ E044 C3 6B E0             jp ay_write
 169+ E047
 170+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 171+ E047              ; The VTOL's engines: jet turbines, not rotors, so a steady roar and whine
 172+ E047              ; rather than a chop.  AY 1, all three channels, kept for them.  They never
 173+ E047              ; stop in play: at zero throttle they idle, as at speed 1.  The interrupt
 174+ E047              ; routine plays them, 50 times a second (engine_tick, interrupts.asm): the
 175+ E047              ; sound's speed spools towards the VTOL's, so pitch and volume rise and fall
 176+ E047              ; smoothly.  (The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is
 177+ E047              ; 109375/P Hz.)
 178+ E047              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 179+ E047              ; Start of each level (next_level): AY 1's mixer for the engines, the sound's
 180+ E047              ; speed 0 (they spool up to the idle), and the interrupt playing them
 181+ E047              engine_start:
 182+ E047 AF                   xor a
 183+ E048 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; (the interrupt off AY 1 meanwhile)
 184+ E04B 21 00 00             ld hl,0
 185+ E04E 22 97 3C             ld (eng_cur),hl
 186+ E051 3E 03                ld a,AY_CHIP_1
 187+ E053 CD 63 E0             call ay_select
 188+ E056 3E 07                ld a,AY_MIXER
 189+ E058 1E 31                ld e,ENG_MIXER
 190+ E05A CD 6B E0             call ay_write
 191+ E05D 3E 01                ld a,1
 192+ E05F 32 89 3C             ld (eng_on),a                   ; the interrupt plays them now
 193+ E062 C9                   ret
 194+ E063
 195+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 196+ E063              ; A = chip (AY_CHIP_n): select it, with both outputs on
 197+ E063              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 198+ E063              ay_select:
 199+ E063 F6 FC                or AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT
 200+ E065 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 201+ E068 ED 79                out (c),a
 202+ E06A C9                   ret
 203+ E06B
 204+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 205+ E06B              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected chip.  Keeps D, E, HL.
 206+ E06B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 207+ E06B              ay_write:
 208+ E06B 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 209+ E06E ED 79                out (c),a
 210+ E070 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 211+ E072 ED 59                out (c),e
 212+ E074 C9                   ret
