2755  E075                      INCLUDE "sound.asm"             ; the players (the interrupt calls them)
# file opened: sound.asm
   1+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E075              ; Z-POLICE - the sound players (in the audio page, PAGE_AUDIO, with
   3+ E075              ; audio.asm and the sounds, sfx_data.asm): called by the interrupt routine
   4+ E075              ; (im2_routine, interrupts.asm) 50 times a second with this page mapped
   5+ E075              ; into slot 7 for them (the page there put back after).  The game asks for
   6+ E075              ; a sound through the resident request bytes (sfx_req, sfx2_req, sfx3_req:
   7+ E075              ; interrupts.asm), so any page can.
   8+ E075              ;==============================================================================
   9+ E075
  10+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  11+ E075              ; The VTOL's engines (audio.asm has the sound's constants and engine_start):
  12+ E075              ; jet turbines, on AY 1.  eng_cur is the speed the engines sound at, in
  13+ E075              ; 1/ENG_FRAC steps; each interrupt it follows the VTOL's, n = |speed| (at
  14+ E075              ; least 1: zero throttle idles as speed 1), by at most ENG_SPIN_UP going up
  15+ E075              ; and ENG_SPIN_DOWN going down: the turbines spool up, and down more slowly,
  16+ E075              ; instead of jumping.  From it:
  17+ E075              ;   A  noise, the roar: period ENG_NOISE0 - m*13/16, volume ENG_ROAR_VOL0 +
  18+ E075              ;      m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  19+ E075              ;      (m = eng_cur/ENG_FRAC, whole steps)
  20+ E075              ;   B  tone, the turbine whine: period ENG_WHINE0 - eng_cur*ENG_WHINE_STEP/
  21+ E075              ;      ENG_FRAC (sliding smoothly), volume ENG_WHINE_VOL0 + m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
  22+ E075              ;   C  the same whine ENG_DETUNE periods lower and ENG_SHIMMER_VOL quieter:
  23+ E075              ;      the two beat, the turbines' shimmer
  24+ E075              ; Written only when eng_cur moves.  Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
  25+ E075              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  26+ E075              engine_tick:
  27+ E075 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
  28+ E078 B7                   or a
  29+ E079 C8                   ret z
  30+ E07A 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)
  31+ E07D B7                   or a
  32+ E07E F2 83 E0             jp p,.pos
  33+ E081 ED 44                neg                             ; reversing: its size
  34+ E083 B7           .pos:   or a
  35+ E084 20 01                jr nz,.n
  36+ E086 3C                   inc a                           ; zero throttle: idle, as speed 1
  37+ E087 FE 1D        .n:     cp SPEED_MAX+1
  38+ E089 38 02                jr c,.nm
  39+ E08B 3E 1C                ld a,SPEED_MAX                  ; (boosting: as flat out)
  40+ E08D 5F           .nm:    ld e,a
  41+ E08E 16 10                ld d,ENG_FRAC
  42+ E090 ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = the target, in 1/ENG_FRAC steps
  43+ E092 2A 97 3C             ld hl,(eng_cur)
  44+ E095 B7                   or a
  45+ E096 ED 52                sbc hl,de                       ; HL = eng_cur - target
  46+ E098 C8                   ret z                           ; there: nothing changes
  47+ E099 38 09                jr c,.up
  48+ E09B 01 FE FF             ld bc,-ENG_SPIN_DOWN            ; above: down a step
  49+ E09E 09                   add hl,bc
  50+ E09F 30 0C                jr nc,.tgt                      ; (less than a step away: there)
  51+ E0A1 19                   add hl,de
  52+ E0A2 18 0A                jr .set
  53+ E0A4 01 04 00     .up:    ld bc,ENG_SPIN_UP               ; below: up a step
  54+ E0A7 09                   add hl,bc
  55+ E0A8 38 03                jr c,.tgt                       ; (reached it)
  56+ E0AA 19                   add hl,de
  57+ E0AB 18 01                jr .set
  58+ E0AD EB           .tgt:   ex de,hl
  59+ E0AE 22 97 3C     .set:   ld (eng_cur),hl
  60+ E0B1 3E FF                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_1
  61+ E0B3 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
  62+ E0B6 ED 79                out (c),a
  63+ E0B8 E5                   push hl
  64+ E0B9 54                   ld d,h                          ; B: the whine's period
  65+ E0BA 5D                   ld e,l
  66+ E0BB 29                   add hl,hl
  67+ E0BC 19                   add hl,de                       ; eng_cur * ENG_WHINE_STEP
  68+ E0BD EB                   ex de,hl
  69+ E0BE 06 04                ld b,4
  70+ E0C0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; / ENG_FRAC
  71+ E0C2                      ASSERT ENG_WHINE_STEP == 3 && ENG_FRAC == 16
  72+ E0C2 3E DE                ld a,ENG_WHINE0
  73+ E0C4 93                   sub e
  74+ E0C5 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = the whine's period
  75+ E0C6 5F                   ld e,a
  76+ E0C7 3E 02                ld a,AY_TONE_B
  77+ E0C9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  78+ E0CC 3E 03                ld a,AY_TONE_B+1
  79+ E0CE 1E 00                ld e,0
  80+ E0D0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  81+ E0D3 7D                   ld a,l                          ; C: a little lower, to beat with B
  82+ E0D4 C6 02                add a,ENG_DETUNE
  83+ E0D6 5F                   ld e,a
  84+ E0D7 3E 04                ld a,AY_TONE_C
  85+ E0D9 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  86+ E0DC 3E 05                ld a,AY_TONE_C+1
  87+ E0DE 1E 00                ld e,0
  88+ E0E0 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
  89+ E0E3 D1                   pop de                          ; m = eng_cur / ENG_FRAC
  90+ E0E4 06 04                ld b,4
  91+ E0E6 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
  92+ E0E8 63                   ld h,e                          ; H = m
  93+ E0E9 54                   ld d,h                          ; A: the roar's noise period
  94+ E0EA 1E 0D                ld e,ENG_NOISE_MUL
  95+ E0EC ED 30                mul d,e
  96+ E0EE 06 04                ld b,4
  97+ E0F0 ED 2A                bsrl de,b                       ; m*13/16
  98+ E0F2 3E 1D                ld a,ENG_NOISE0
  99+ E0F4 93                   sub e
 100+ E0F5 5F                   ld e,a
 101+ E0F6 3E 06                ld a,AY_NOISE
 102+ E0F8 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 103+ E0FB 54                   ld d,h                          ; the volumes: louder with speed
 104+ E0FC 1E 07                ld e,ENG_VOL_MUL
 105+ E0FE ED 30                mul d,e
 106+ E100 06 05                ld b,5
 107+ E102 ED 2A                bsrl de,b
 108+ E104 7B                   ld a,e
 109+ E105 6F                   ld l,a                          ; L = m*ENG_VOL_MUL/32
 110+ E106 C6 04                add a,ENG_ROAR_VOL0
 111+ E108 5F                   ld e,a
 112+ E109 3E 08                ld a,AY_VOL_A
 113+ E10B CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 114+ E10E 7D                   ld a,l
 115+ E10F C6 02                add a,ENG_WHINE_VOL0
 116+ E111 5F                   ld e,a
 117+ E112 3E 09                ld a,AY_VOL_B
 118+ E114 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 119+ E117 7B                   ld a,e
 120+ E118 D6 02                sub ENG_SHIMMER_VOL
 121+ E11A 5F                   ld e,a
 122+ E11B 3E 0A                ld a,AY_VOL_C
 123+ E11D                      ; fall through
 124+ E11D
 125+ E11D              ; A = register, E = value: write it to the selected AY chip (here: the
 126+ E11D              ; interrupt's own, as ay_write is in a page that may not be in).  Keeps D,
 127+ E11D              ; E, HL.
 128+ E11D              isr_ay:
 129+ E11D 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 130+ E120 ED 79                out (c),a
 131+ E122 06 BF                ld b,high AY_DATA_PORT
 132+ E124 ED 59                out (c),e
 133+ E126 C9                   ret
 134+ E127
 135+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 136+ E127              ; Sound effects, three voices: the weapons on AY 2 (sfx_req), explosions on
 137+ E127              ; AY 3's channels A and B (sfx2_req), and splats on AY 3's channel C
 138+ E127              ; (sfx3_req: a tone only, as the chip's noise is the explosions'), so none
 139+ E127              ; cuts another.  (The splats write only channel C's tone and volume, and
 140+ E127              ; the explosions leave channel C alone, its tone kept on in the mixer.)  The
 141+ E127              ; engines have AY 1.  The game asks for a sound by putting its number in a
 142+ E127              ; voice's request byte (SFX_*, audio.asm): one byte, so safe from any page
 143+ E127              ; at any time; only the interrupt writes the AY chips.  Each voice plays one
 144+ E127              ; sound at a time: a new one cuts the last.  A sound is a list of steps, one
 145+ E127              ; an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value pairs, ended by
 146+ E127              ; SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (the sound is over).
 147+ E127              ; Nothing while eng_on is 0 (menus).
 148+ E127              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 149+ E127              sfx_tick:
 150+ E127 3A 89 3C             ld a,(eng_on)
 151+ E12A B7                   or a
 152+ E12B C8                   ret z
 153+ E12C 21 8A 3C             ld hl,sfx_req                   ; the weapons, AY 2
 154+ E12F 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 155+ E131 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 156+ E134 21 8D 3C             ld hl,sfx2_req                  ; explosions, AY 3 (A, B)
 157+ E137 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 158+ E139 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 159+ E13C 21 90 3C             ld hl,sfx3_req                  ; splats, AY 3 (C)
 160+ E13F 3E FD                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_3
 161+ E141 CD 49 E1             call sfx_voice
 162+ E144 21 93 3C             ld hl,sfx4_req                  ; the base's warnings, AY 2 (C)
 163+ E147 3E FE                ld a,AY_SELECT|AY_LEFT|AY_RIGHT|AY_CHIP_2
 164+ E149                      ; fall through
 165+ E149
 166+ E149              ; HL -> a voice (its request byte, then its sound's next step, a word: 0
 167+ E149              ; none), A = its AY chip's select value: start a sound asked for, and play
 168+ E149              ; the next step
 169+ E149              sfx_voice:
 170+ E149 32 96 3C             ld (sv_sel),a
 171+ E14C 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; a new sound asked for?
 172+ E14D B7                   or a
 173+ E14E 28 13                jr z,.play
 174+ E150 36 00                ld (hl),0                       ; (taken)
 175+ E152 E5                   push hl
 176+ E153 21 8C E1             ld hl,sfx_table-2
 177+ E156 87                   add a,a
 178+ E157 ED 31                add hl,a
 179+ E159 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 180+ E15A 23                   inc hl
 181+ E15B 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> it
 182+ E15C E1                   pop hl
 183+ E15D 23                   inc hl
 184+ E15E 73                   ld (hl),e                       ; it starts now (cutting any other)
 185+ E15F 23                   inc hl
 186+ E160 72                   ld (hl),d
 187+ E161 2B                   dec hl
 188+ E162 2B                   dec hl
 189+ E163 23           .play:  inc hl
 190+ E164 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 191+ E165 23                   inc hl
 192+ E166 56                   ld d,(hl)                       ; DE -> the next step; HL -> its high byte
 193+ E167 7A                   ld a,d
 194+ E168 B3                   or e
 195+ E169 C8                   ret z                           ; nothing playing
 196+ E16A E5                   push hl
 197+ E16B 3A 96 3C             ld a,(sv_sel)
 198+ E16E 01 FD FF             ld bc,AY_CTRL_PORT
 199+ E171 ED 79                out (c),a
 200+ E173 EB                   ex de,hl
 201+ E174 7E           .lp:    ld a,(hl)                       ; this step's register / value pairs
 202+ E175 23                   inc hl
 203+ E176 FE FE                cp SFX_STEP
 204+ E178 28 0E                jr z,.step
 205+ E17A FE FF                cp SFX_END
 206+ E17C 28 07                jr z,.end
 207+ E17E 5E                   ld e,(hl)
 208+ E17F 23                   inc hl
 209+ E180 CD 1D E1             call isr_ay
 210+ E183 18 EF                jr .lp
 211+ E185 21 00 00     .end:   ld hl,0                         ; over
 212+ E188 EB           .step:  ex de,hl                        ; (the next step, next interrupt)
 213+ E189 E1                   pop hl
 214+ E18A 72                   ld (hl),d
 215+ E18B 2B                   dec hl
 216+ E18C 73                   ld (hl),e
 217+ E18D C9                   ret

2756  E18E                      INCLUDE "sfx_data.asm"          ; the sound effects (sfx_tick plays them)
# file opened: sfx_data.asm
   1+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
   2+ E18E              ; Z-POLICE - sound effect data (in the audio page, with the players,
   3+ E18E              ; sound.asm: mapped into slot 7 by the interrupt routine while it plays)
   4+ E18E              ;
   5+ E18E              ; Played on AY 2 by sfx_tick (interrupts.asm); the game asks for one with
   6+ E18E              ; ld a,SFX_n / ld (sfx_req),a (the numbers are in audio.asm).  A sound is a
   7+ E18E              ; list of steps, one an interrupt (20 ms): each step is AY register / value
   8+ E18E              ; pairs, ended by SFX_STEP (the next step next interrupt) or SFX_END (over).
   9+ E18E              ; The Next's AYs run at 1.75 MHz: a tone of period P is 109375/P Hz; a
  10+ E18E              ; lower noise period is a brighter hiss.
  11+ E18E              ;==============================================================================
  12+ E18E
  13+ E18E              ; One step of a zap: channel A at tone period p, channel B 2 periods flat
  14+ E18E              ; (the two beat: a buzz), volumes v and v-2
  15+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_ZAP p, v
  16+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_A, low (p), AY_TONE_A+1, high (p)
  17+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low ((p)+2), AY_TONE_B+1, high ((p)+2)
  18+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, v, AY_VOL_B, (v)-2, SFX_STEP
  19+ E18E                  ENDM
  20+ E18E
  21+ E18E              ; One step of a woosh: channel A's noise at period n, volume v
  22+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_WOOSH n, v
  23+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, n, AY_VOL_A, v, SFX_STEP
  24+ E18E                  ENDM
  25+ E18E
  26+ E18E              ; An explosion: a deep noise (channel A, darkening: period 16 up to 30) over
  27+ E18E              ; a low rumble (channel B, BOOM_RUMBLE), both from volume peak (B 2 less)
  28+ E18E              ; fading to nothing over len steps.  (A falling level is an exponential fade:
  29+ E18E              ; the AY's levels are logarithmic.)
  30+ E18E              BOOM_RUMBLE     equ 2735            ; 109375 / 2735 = 40 Hz
  31+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_BOOM peak, len
  32+ E18E ~                    db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_BOOM       ; (channel C: the splats', left alone)
  33+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_B, low BOOM_RUMBLE, AY_TONE_B+1, high BOOM_RUMBLE
  34+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL 0
  35+ E18E ~                    DUP len
  36+ E18E ~                    db AY_NOISE, 16 + (BOOM_I*15)/(len)
  37+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, ((peak)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  38+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_B, (((peak)-2)*((len)-BOOM_I)+(len)-1)/(len)
  39+ E18E ~                    db SFX_STEP
  40+ E18E ~            BOOM_I  DEFL BOOM_I+1
  41+ E18E ~                    EDUP
  42+ E18E ~                    db AY_VOL_A, 0, AY_VOL_B, 0, SFX_END
  43+ E18E                  ENDM
  44+ E18E
  45+ E18E              ; One step of a splat: channel C (only: see sfx_tick) at tone period p,
  46+ E18E              ; volume v
  47+ E18E                  MACRO SFX_SPLAT_STEP p, v
  48+ E18E ~                    db AY_TONE_C, low (p), AY_TONE_C+1, high (p), AY_VOL_C, v, SFX_STEP
  49+ E18E                  ENDM
  50+ E18E
  51+ E18E              ; The sounds, by number (SFX_*, from 1)
  52+ E18E              sfx_table:
  53+ E18E B0 E1                dw sfx_mg                       ; SFX_MG
  54+ E190 B3 E9                dw sfx_laser                    ; SFX_LASER
  55+ E192 D5 E1                dw sfx_chain                    ; SFX_CHAIN
  56+ E194 1F E2                dw sfx_rocket                   ; SFX_ROCKET
  57+ E196 58 E2                dw sfx_missile                  ; SFX_MISSILE
  58+ E198 FA E1                dw sfx_autocannon               ; SFX_AUTOCANNON
  59+ E19A 8C E3                dw sfx_boom_rocket              ; SFX_BOOM_ROCKET
  60+ E19C AF E2                dw sfx_boom_missile             ; SFX_BOOM_MISSILE
  61+ E19E 3F E4                dw sfx_boom_autocannon          ; SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON
  62+ E1A0 9E E4                dw sfx_boom_prox                ; SFX_BOOM_PROX
  63+ E1A2 78 E9                dw sfx_splat                    ; SFX_SPLAT
  64+ E1A4 12 E9                dw sfx_crash                    ; SFX_CRASH
  65+ E1A6 F7 E8                dw sfx_lock                     ; SFX_LOCK
  66+ E1A8 E1 E4                dw sfx_charge                   ; SFX_CHARGE
  67+ E1AA 3C E7                dw sfx_bolt                     ; SFX_BOLT
  68+ E1AC D9 E8                dw sfx_warn_low                 ; SFX_WARN_LOW
  69+ E1AE E8 E8                dw sfx_warn_mid                 ; SFX_WARN_MID
  70+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_MG == 1 && SFX_LASER == 2 && SFX_CHAIN == 3
  71+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_ROCKET == 4 && SFX_MISSILE == 5 && SFX_AUTOCANNON == 6
  72+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_BOOM_ROCKET == 7 && SFX_BOOM_MISSILE == 8
  73+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_BOOM_AUTOCANNON == 9 && SFX_BOOM_PROX == 10 && SFX_SPLAT == 11
  74+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_CRASH == 12 && SFX_LOCK == 13
  75+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_CHARGE == 14 && SFX_BOLT == 15
  76+ E1B0                      ASSERT SFX_WARN_LOW == 16 && SFX_WARN_MID == 17
  77+ E1B0                      ASSERT ($ - sfx_table)/2 == SFX_LAST
  78+ E1B0
  79+ E1B0              ; The machine gun, heavy: a sharp crack (bright noise) dropping into a deep
  80+ E1B0              ; boom (noise, channel A) over a low thump (about 70 Hz, channel B), gone in
  81+ E1B0              ; 80 ms
  82+ E1B0              MG_THUMP        equ 1563            ; tone period: 109375 / 1563 = 70 Hz
  83+ E1B0              sfx_mg:
  84+ E1B0 07 31                db AY_MIXER, SFX_MIX_NOISE_A_TONE_B
  85+ E1B2 02 1B 03 06          db AY_TONE_B, low MG_THUMP, AY_TONE_B+1, high MG_THUMP
  86+ E1B6 06 04 08 0D          db AY_NOISE, 4, AY_VOL_A, 13, AY_VOL_B, 11, SFX_STEP     ; crack
  86+ E1BA 09 0B FE
  87+ E1BD 06 12 08 0A          db AY_NOISE, 18, AY_VOL_A, 10, AY_VOL_B, 9, SFX_STEP     ; boom
  87+ E1C1 09 09 FE
  88+ E1C4 06 1A 08 06          db AY_NOISE, 26, AY_VOL_A, 6, AY_VOL_B, 5, SFX_STEP
  88+ E1C8 09 05 FE

 161+ E2AF              ; Explosions (rocket_blast, weapons.asm; on AY 3).  Each one's loudness in
 162+ E2AF              ; proportion to its blast's size, damage x reach (game units):
 163+ E2AF              ;   missile 15 x 256 = 3840, rocket 20 x 64 = 1280, autocannon 4 x 38 = 152,
 164+ E2AF              ;   proximity 3 x 25 = 75.
 165+ E2AF              ; Sound level is logarithmic (about 2 AY levels each doubling), so the peak
 166+ E2AF              ; is 15 + 2*log2(size / the missile's): 15, 12, 6, 4; and the bigger the

 177+ E4E1                      ASSERT MISSILE_DMG*MISSILE_R == 3840 && BLAST_DMG*BLAST_R == 1280

 179+ E4E1
 180+ E4E1              ; The VTOL hitting a building (player.asm; on AY 3, as the explosions): a
 181+ E4E1              ; low crunch, like a missile's blast but deeper and shorter.  A cracking
 182+ E4E1              ; hit (brighter noise, full volume) drops at once into the deepest noise
 183+ E4E1              ; (period 31) over a lower rumble than the blasts' (about 27 Hz, channel B),
 184+ E4E1              ; fading over 260 ms.
 185+ E4E1              CRASH_RUMBLE    equ 4000            ; 109375 / 4000 = 27 Hz
 186+ E4E1                      ASSERT CRASH_RUMBLE < 4096
 187+ E4E1              CRASH_LEN       equ 10              ; the fade, steps
 188+ E4E1              ; The devil charging its lightning (devil.asm), its last DV_HUM_T
 189+ E4E1              ; interrupts (3 s; AY 3 channel C, as the splats, which wait meanwhile:
 190+ E4E1              ; dv_hum): an electric whine rising from CHG_F0 to CHG_F1 Hz (in steps of
 191+ E4E1              ; even frequency) and swelling from volume 4 to 15, warbling (every other
 192+ E4E1              ; step 1/12 flat), a step every 2 interrupts
 193+ E4E1              CHG_STEPS       equ 75              ; (x 2 interrupts: 3 s)
 194+ E4E1              CHG_F0          equ 80
 195+ E4E1              CHG_F1          equ 1600
 196+ E4E1              sfx_charge:
 197+ E4E1              CHG_I   DEFL 0
 198+ E4E1                      DUP CHG_STEPS
 199+ E4E1             >CHG_P   DEFL 109375*(CHG_STEPS-1) / (CHG_F0*(CHG_STEPS-1) + (CHG_F1-CHG_F0)*CHG_I)
 200+ E4E1             >        IF CHG_I & 1
 201+ E4E1 ~           >CHG_P   DEFL CHG_P + CHG_P/12
 202+ E4E1             >        ENDIF
 203+ E4E1 04 57 05 05 >        db AY_TONE_C, low CHG_P, AY_TONE_C+1, high CHG_P
 204+ E4E5 0A 04       >        db AY_VOL_C, 4 + (11*CHG_I)/(CHG_STEPS-1)
 205+ E4E7 FE FE       >        db SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 206+ E4E9             >CHG_I   DEFL CHG_I+1
 199+ E4E9             >CHG_P   DEFL 109375*(CHG_STEPS-1) / (CHG_F0*(CHG_STEPS-1) + (CHG_F1-CHG_F0)*CHG_I)
 200+ E4E9             >        IF CHG_I & 1
 201+ E4E9             >CHG_P   DEFL CHG_P + CHG_P/12
 202+ E4E9             >        ENDIF
 203+ E4E9 04 99 05 04 >        db AY_TONE_C, low CHG_P, AY_TONE_C+1, high CHG_P
 204+ E4ED 0A 04       >        db AY_VOL_C, 4 + (11*CHG_I)/(CHG_STEPS-1)
 205+ E4EF FE FE       >        db SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 206+ E4F1             >CHG_I   DEFL CHG_I+1
 199+ E4F1             >CHG_P   DEFL 109375*(CHG_STEPS-1) / (CHG_F0*(CHG_STEPS-1) + (CHG_F1-CHG_F0)*CHG_I)
 200+ E4F1             >        IF CHG_I & 1
 201+ E4F1 ~           >CHG_P   DEFL CHG_P + CHG_P/12
 202+ E4F1             >        ENDIF
 203+ E4F1 04 87 05 03 >        db AY_TONE_C, low CHG_P, AY_TONE_C+1, high CHG_P
 204+ E4F5 0A 04       >        db AY_VOL_C, 4 + (11*CHG_I)/(CHG_STEPS-1)
 205+ E4F7 FE FE       >        db SFX_STEP, SFX_STEP
 206+ E4F9             >CHG_I   DEFL CHG_I+1
 199+ E4F9             >CHG_P   DEFL 109375*(CHG_STEPS-1) / (CHG_F0*(CHG_STEPS-1) + (CHG_F1-CHG_F0)*CHG_I)

2760  EA15              ; Game logic pages: assembled at $C000, swapped into slot 6.  They may call
2761  EA15              ; the core page in slot 7 (main_loop has the keys there while they run).
2762  EA15              ;==============================================================================
2763  EA15                      MMU LOGIC_SLOT e, PAGE_PLAYER, LOGIC_ADDR
2764  C000                      ORG LOGIC_ADDR
2765  C000                      INCLUDE "player.asm"
# file opened: player.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - player page (8K page PAGE_PLAYER, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Keyboard input, movement along the heading, world-edge clamping and
   5+ C000              ; building collision.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,
   6+ C000              ; PAGE_PLAYER, with the keys page (key_held) in slot 7.
   7+ C000              ; Uses the resident helpers get_sin, fmul and bld_height; camera state (cam_x/z/y, yaw, pitch, speed) is shared and
   8+ C000              ; stays in zpolice.asm.
   9+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  10+ C000
  11+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  12+ C000              ; Player input and movement
  13+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  14+ C000              update_player:
  15+ C000 AF                   xor a
  16+ C001 D3 FE                out ($FE),a                     ; border back to black
  17+ C003 21 80 01             ld hl,YAW_RATE                  ; this frame's turn (a frame's worth)
  18+ C006 CD 93 A7             call fs_mul
  19+ C009 22 89 C4             ld (yaw_step),hl
  20+ C00C                      ; remember position in case we fly into something
  21+ C00C 21 CF AE             ld hl,cam_x                     ; (and the heading: turning swings
  22+ C00F 11 7C C4             ld de,old_pos                   ; the VTOL's nose and tail)
  23+ C012 01 0A 00             ld bc,10                        ; cam_x(3) cam_z(3) cam_y(2) yaw(2)
  24+ C015 ED B0                ldir
  25+ C017 3A ED AE             ld a,(vtol_dead)
  26+ C01A B7                   or a
  27+ C01B 28 07                jr z,.alive
  28+ C01D AF                   xor a
  29+ C01E 32 81 AF             ld (boost_on),a                 ; (no boost in a wreck)
  30+ C021 C3 E6 C3             jp vtol_wreck                   ; destroyed: out of control
  31+ C024              .alive:
  32+ C024                      ; (keys: kbd_scan has read them; actions from input.asm)
  33+ C024                      ; --- boost (zpolice.asm: BOOST_*): while on, the speed keys and the
  34+ C024                      ; air brake don't change the speed, and each frame burns a fuel
  35+ C024 3A 81 AF             ld a,(boost_on)
  36+ C027 B7                   or a
  37+ C028 28 39                jr z,.nb
  38+ C02A 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)
  39+ C02D FE 38                cp BOOST_SPEED
  40+ C02F 20 27                jr nz,.bend                     ; stopped meanwhile (a collision)
  41+ C031 CD 80 AC             call vtol_on_floor
  42+ C034 28 22                jr z,.bend                      ; set down: off (the brake stops it)
  43+ C036 3E 13                ld a,K_BOOST
  44+ C038 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  45+ C03B 20 15                jr nz,.boff                     ; pressed again: off
  46+ C03D 3A 53 A8             ld a,(fsteps)                   ; a fuel a frame's worth
  47+ C040 4F                   ld c,a
  48+ C041 3A 80 AF             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  49+ C044 91                   sub c
  50+ C045 28 07                jr z,.bout
  51+ C047 38 05                jr c,.bout
  52+ C049 32 80 AF             ld (boost_fuel),a
  53+ C04C 18 0E                jr .bkeep                       ; still burning
  54+ C04E AF           .bout:  xor a
  55+ C04F 32 80 AF             ld (boost_fuel),a
  56+ C052 3A 82 AF     .boff:  ld a,(boost_spd)                ; off (or out of fuel): the speed it
  57+ C055 32 DB AE             ld (speed),a                    ; had before
  58+ C058 AF           .bend:  xor a
  59+ C059 32 81 AF             ld (boost_on),a
  60+ C05C AF           .bkeep: xor a                           ; (no air brake this frame)
  61+ C05D 32 88 C4             ld (ab_on),a
  62+ C060 C3 99 C1             jp .nw
  63+ C063 3E 13        .nb:    ld a,K_BOOST                    ; off: pressed to start it?
  64+ C065 CD CF E0             call key_pressed
  65+ C068 28 2B                jr z,.nbs
  66+ C06A 3A 7F AF             ld a,(boost_fitted)
  67+ C06D B7                   or a
  68+ C06E 28 25                jr z,.nbs                       ; no booster
  69+ C070 3A 80 AF             ld a,(boost_fuel)
  70+ C073 B7                   or a
  71+ C074 28 1F                jr z,.nbs                       ; no fuel
  72+ C076 CD 80 AC             call vtol_on_floor
  73+ C079 28 1A                jr z,.nbs                       ; landed: not on the ground
  74+ C07B 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)
  75+ C07E CB 7F                bit 7,a
  76+ C080 20 13                jr nz,.nbs                      ; reversing
  77+ C082 FE 0E                cp BOOST_MIN
  78+ C084 38 0F                jr c,.nbs                       ; under half speed
  79+ C086 32 82 AF             ld (boost_spd),a
  80+ C089 3E 38                ld a,BOOST_SPEED                ; on: twice the top speed at once
  81+ C08B 32 DB AE             ld (speed),a
  82+ C08E 3E 01                ld a,1
  83+ C090 32 81 AF             ld (boost_on),a
  84+ C093 18 C7                jr .bkeep
  85+ C095              .nbs:
  86+ C095                      ; --- landed (resting on the road, a roof or the pad): the speed keys
  87+ C095                      ; only bring it back to 0 (speeding up only from reverse, slowing
  88+ C095                      ; only from forwards), and any speed is braked away as the air brake
  89+ C095                      ; does (as if Z were held), with a shake
  90+ C095 CD 80 AC             call vtol_on_floor
  91+ C098 20 4C                jr nz,.fly
  92+ C09A 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP
  93+ C09C CD BE E0             call key_held
  94+ C09F 28 12                jr z,.lq
  95+ C0A1 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)
  96+ C0A4 CB 7F                bit 7,a
  97+ C0A6 28 0B                jr z,.lq                        ; not reversing: no
  98+ C0A8 21 53 A8             ld hl,fsteps
  99+ C0AB 86                   add a,(hl)
 100+ C0AC FA B0 C0             jp m,.lqs
 101+ C0AF AF                   xor a                           ; (not past 0)
 102+ C0B0 32 DB AE     .lqs:   ld (speed),a
 103+ C0B3 3E 01        .lq:    ld a,K_SPEED_DN
 104+ C0B5 CD BE E0             call key_held
 105+ C0B8 28 13                jr z,.lb
 106+ C0BA 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)
 107+ C0BD B7                   or a
 108+ C0BE 28 0D                jr z,.lb                        ; at 0 or reversing: no
 109+ C0C0 FA CD C0             jp m,.lb
 110+ C0C3 21 53 A8             ld hl,fsteps
 111+ C0C6 96                   sub (hl)
 112+ C0C7 30 01                jr nc,.lds
 113+ C0C9 AF                   xor a                           ; (not past 0)
 114+ C0CA 32 DB AE     .lds:   ld (speed),a
 115+ C0CD 3A DB AE     .lb:    ld a,(speed)
 116+ C0D0 B7                   or a
 117+ C0D1 CA 1A C1             jp z,.na                        ; stopped (Z: nothing to brake)
 118+ C0D4 3A 60 A8             ld a,(shake_t)                  ; a shake, unless one is going
 119+ C0D7 B7                   or a
 120+ C0D8 20 05                jr nz,.lbr
 121+ C0DA 3E 06                ld a,SHAKE_LEN
 122+ C0DC 32 60 A8             ld (shake_t),a
 123+ C0DF AF           .lbr:   xor a
 124+ C0E0 32 88 C4             ld (ab_on),a
 125+ C0E3 C3 48 C1             jp .brk                         ; braked, as by the air brake
 126+ C0E6              .fly:
 127+ C0E6                      ; --- speed ---
 128+ C0E6 3E 00                ld a,K_SPEED_UP                 ; (by SPEED_STEP, 1, a frame's worth)
 129+ C0E8 CD BE E0             call key_held
 130+ C0EB 28 13                jr z,.nq
 131+ C0ED 3A DB AE             ld a,(speed)

 526+ C3E6              ; The VTOL has been destroyed (vtol_dead): the controls do nothing.  It
 527+ C3E6              ; spins DEAD_SPIN a frame and falls, a unit a frame faster each frame (up

 587+ C44F              ; One damping step: move the signed 8.8 pitch (pitch_frac/pitch) towards 0
 588+ C44F              ; by max(PDAMP_MIN, |whole pitch| * PDAMP_K), stopping exactly at 0.
 589+ C44F              ; Calculated rather than looked up: the Z80N MUL makes it as quick as a
 590+ C44F              ; table, and the curve stays editable through the two equates.
 591+ C44F              pitch_damp:
 592+ C44F 2A D9 AE             ld hl,(pitch_frac)
 593+ C452 7C                   ld a,h
 594+ C453 B5                   or l
 595+ C454 C8                   ret z                           ; already level
 596+ C455 7C                   ld a,h
 597+ C456 F5                   push af                         ; sign
 598+ C457 CD 91 AE             call abs_hl
 599+ C45A 54                   ld d,h                          ; whole part of |pitch|
 600+ C45B 1E 00                ld e,PDAMP_K
 601+ C45D ED 30                mul d,e                         ; DE = step
 602+ C45F 7A                   ld a,d
 603+ C460 B7                   or a
 604+ C461 20 08                jr nz,.sub
 605+ C463 7B                   ld a,e
 606+ C464 FE 80                cp PDAMP_MIN
 607+ C466 30 03                jr nc,.sub
 608+ C468 11 80 00             ld de,PDAMP_MIN
 609+ C46B B7           .sub:   or a
 610+ C46C ED 52                sbc hl,de
 611+ C46E 30 03                jr nc,.sgn
 612+ C470 21 00 00             ld hl,0                         ; would pass level: stop at 0
 613+ C473 F1           .sgn:   pop af
 614+ C474 17                   rla                             ; carry = was nose down
 615+ C475 DC 8A AE             call c,neg_hl
 616+ C478 22 D9 AE             ld (pitch_frac),hl
 617+ C47B C9                   ret

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - weapons page (8K page PAGE_WEAPONS, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Player weapons.  Paged in by main_loop with nextreg LOGIC_MMU,PAGE_WEAPONS
   5+ C000              ; (the keys page in slot 7) after
   6+ C000              ; the frame is set up (it uses sin_y/cos_y/sin_p/cos_p) and the zombies have
   7+ C000              ; moved.  Bullet state lives in the resident `bullets` table so that the city
   8+ C000              ; page can draw the tracers (draw_bullets).
   9+ C000              ;
  10+ C000              ; Keys 1-5 select the weapon slot that SPACE fires (wpn_sel: 1 = the centre
  11+ C000              ; slot, 2-5 = the wing pylons).  An empty slot isn't selected: the HUD
  12+ C000              ; flashes it instead (wflash_slot / wflash_t).  What is fitted where is set
  13+ C000              ; on the load-out screen between levels (loadout.asm).
  14+ C000              ;
  15+ C000              ; Machine gun (WPN_GUN, the centre slot): hold SPACE to fire one round every
  16+ C000              ; GUN_INTERVAL frames.  Rounds leave the ship's centre line 0.5 m below the
  17+ C000              ; camera and fly straight along the view direction at 500 m/s until they hit
  18+ C000              ; something.
  19+ C000              ;
  20+ C000              ; Collision, every frame for every round in flight: the path from its last
  21+ C000              ; position to its new one (BULLET_STEP long) is walked cell by cell through
  22+ C000              ; the city grid, in order (a 2D DDA on the horizontal distance s along the
  23+ C000              ; path).  The first thing met ends the path:
  24+ C000              ;   * a building cell: hit where the path enters the cell if it is below the
  25+ C000              ;     roof there (a wall), otherwise where it drops below the roof (the roof);
  26+ C000              ;   * a street cell marked as holding zombies (CELL_ZOMBIE): those in it, each a box
  27+ C000              ;     0.5 m wide and 2 m tall, nearest along the path first;
  28+ C000              ;   * the ground, where the path reaches height 0;
  29+ C000              ;   * leaving the GRID x GRID map: the round is gone.
  30+ C000              ; A round that hits is drawn once at the impact point, then freed.  A zombie
  31+ C000              ; that is hit loses B_DMG hit points; at 0 it is killed (its map blip
  32+ C000              ; removed, its record made inactive).  A rocket also bursts (rocket_blast).
  33+ C000              ;
  34+ C000              ; Rocket pod (WPN_ROCKETS, a wing pylon, ROCKET_SHOTS rockets): rockets are
  35+ C000              ; rounds too (B_KIND = BK_ROCKET), at 150 m/s and drawn as a short white
  36+ C000              ; streak with a yellow trail.  Wherever one stops (a building, the ground,
  37+ C000              ; a zombie) rocket_blast does BLAST_DMG to every zombie, human and base tile
  38+ C000              ; within BLAST_R on each axis, and sprays BLAST_PARTS orange particles.
  39+ C000              ;
  40+ C000              ; Autocannon (WPN_AUTOCANNON, a wing pylon, AUTOCANNON_SHOTS shells): the
  41+ C000              ; machine gun's rounds (B_KIND = BK_AUTOCANNON, drawn as tracers) one every
  42+ C000              ; AUTOCANNON_INTERVAL frames; each bursts where it stops: AUTOCANNON_DMG
  43+ C000              ; within AUTOCANNON_R (3 m) on each axis, AUTOCANNON_PARTS particles.
  44+ C000              ;
  45+ C000              ; Proximity cannon (WPN_PROX, a wing pylon, PROX_SHOTS shells): the
  46+ C000              ; autocannon (B_KIND = BK_PROX), its shells also bursting when they pass within
  47+ C000              ; PROX_R (2 m) of a monster (b_pr widens the monster hit boxes,
  48+ C000              ; cell_zombies); the burst does PROX_DMG within PROX_R on each axis.
  49+ C000              ;
  50+ C000              ; Missile pod (WPN_MISSILE, a wing pylon, MISSILE_SHOTS missiles): as the
  51+ C000              ; rockets (B_KIND = BK_MISSILE, drawn the same) at half the speed; the burst
  52+ C000              ; does MISSILE_DMG within MISSILE_R (1.0 tile) on each axis, and sprays
  53+ C000              ; MISSILE_PARTS particles.  Guided: one fires only with a target locked
  54+ C000              ; (lock_update: the reticule), and turns towards it (msl_steer) at
  55+ C000              ; MISSILE_TURN a frame until it is more than LOCK_RANGE away.
  56+ C000              ;
  57+ C000              ; Damage: each round carries its damage (B_DMG): machine gun GUN_DMG, chain
  58+ C000              ; gun CHAIN_DMG, the laser LASER_DMG a beam frame, a rocket none directly
  59+ C000              ; (only its blast).  A zombie dies when its hit points (+18) run out.
  60+ C000              ;
  61+ C000              ; Positions are world units (1 tile = 20 m = 256 units, 1 m = 12.8).  Along the path,
  62+ C000              ; x = x0 + s*sinY, z = z0 + s*cosY and y = y0 + s*slope, with sinY/cosY the
  63+ C000              ; S7.8 heading at firing and slope = tan(pitch) in S7.8.
  64+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  65+ C000
  66+ C000              ; A = the ticks between this weapon's shots: the next due that many on
  67+ C000              ; from when this one was (gun_ovs: past due by up to a frame), so the rate
  68+ C000              ; holds whatever the frames' length; at least a tick away

 371+ C27B              ; Aim assist, for a centre slot round IX just spawned, pointing where the gun
 372+ C27B              ; does (or a linked chain gun's, from its own muzzle: each on its own): the
 373+ C27B              ; nearest monster drawn last frame (a monster behind a building isn't: bit 1
 374+ C27B              ; of +31) near the gun's crosshair column (aa_col) with its middle within
 375+ C27B              ; AIM_DEV steps of the path, or its box on the path already.  The round turns to its middle, at most
 376+ C27B              ; AIM_DEV steps sideways and AIM_DEV up or down: aa_d and aa_ds, kept for the
 377+ C27B              ; frame's shots (aim_apply) and the sight.  Only the round: the view doesn't
 378+ C27B              ; move.  A chain gun's spread goes on top.
 379+ C27B              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------

 739+ C565              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 740+ C565              ; The missile lock, each frame in flight.  With the missile pod selected the
 741+ C565              ; reticule is shown (ret_on).  Searching (lock_state 0), it wanders the view.
 742+ C565              ; A monster drawn last frame (fig_seen: +31) within LOCK_RANGE of the VTOL
 743+ C565              ; along x and z, the nearest, becomes the target (lock_tgt): locking (1),
 744+ C565              ; the reticule moves to where it was drawn (+32, +33) at RET_STEP pixels a
 745+ C565              ; frame, and after LOCK_TIME frames on it (within LOCK_NEAR) the target is
 746+ C565              ; locked (2): the lock tone, and the reticule stays on it.  The target lost
 747+ C565              ; (killed, out of view, out of range) it searches again.  With a target,
 748+ C565              ; K_TARGET (M) moves to the next one (lk_next).  Then the drawn marks are
 749+ C565              ; cleared for this frame's drawing.
 750+ C565              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 751+ C565              lock_update:
 752+ C565 CD 66 CF             call sel_slot

1631+ CBBA              ; A lich's fireballs, every frame (not with the VTOL a wreck).  A lich with
1632+ CBBA              ; its reload done (LICH_WAIT 0) and the VTOL within FB_RANGE fires at where
1633+ CBBA              ; the VTOL will be: from its velocity (its move last frame, sideways and up
1634+ CBBA              ; or down too) and the flight time at FB_MS, worked out twice over.  The
1635+ CBBA              ; aim is then turned by up to FB_DEV each way (round_spread).  A
1636+ CBBA              ; fireball is a round (BK_FIREBALL, in its own records: the player's guns
1637+ CBBA              ; can't use them up) that passes through monsters and stops at a building,
1638+ CBBA              ; the ground, the VTOL (within FB_HIT_R: fb_step) or after FB_FRAMES frames
1639+ CBBA              ; (FB_RANGE).  Wherever it stops it bursts (rocket_blast): FB_DMG within
1640+ CBBA              ; FB_R to the VTOL, humans and base tiles, not to monsters.

2130+ CF70              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2131+ CF70              ; Landed (update_weapons): on the base pad, repair and reload.  The VTOL
2132+ CF70              ; gains 1 hit point every REPAIR_FRAMES frames up to VTOL_HP; each slot
2133+ CF70              ; whose weapon reloads (wpn_cfg, zpolice.asm: its full load and frames a
2134+ CF70              ; shot) gains a
2135+ CF70              ; shot every that many frames up to its full load.  The counts start afresh
2136+ CF70              ; each landing (svc_on), so a shot or hit point takes the whole interval.
2137+ CF70              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2138+ CF70              pad_service:

2189+ CFD6 32 EC AE             ld (vtol_hp),a

2191+ CFDA B7                   or a

2197+ CFE7 DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+WPN_TYPE)

2202+ CFF0 23                   inc hl
2203+ CFF1 7E                   ld a,(hl)                       ; ticks a shot (WCFG_RELOAD)
2204+ CFF2 E1                   pop hl
2205+ CFF3 B7                   or a
2206+ CFF4 28 28                jr z,.nx                        ; doesn't reload (or an empty slot)
2207+ CFF6 47                   ld b,a                          ; B = ticks a shot
2208+ CFF7 3A 50 A8             ld a,(dt)
2209+ CFFA 5F                   ld e,a                          ; E = this frame's ticks to use
2210+ CFFB DD 7E 01     .rs:    ld a,(ix+WPN_AMMO)
2211+ CFFE B9                   cp c
2212+ CFFF 30 1B                jr nc,.full
2213+ D001 7E                   ld a,(hl)
2214+ D002 B7                   or a
2215+ D003 20 01                jr nz,.cnt
2216+ D005 78                   ld a,b                          ; a new interval
2217+ D006 93           .cnt:   sub e
2218+ D007 28 05                jr z,.got

2221+ D00C 18 10                jr .nx

2227+ D017 B7                   or a

2235+ D024 10 C0                djnz .sl

2238+ D027              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2239+ D027              ; Pulse laser: SPACE held with the laser in the centre slot fires a beam for
2240+ D027              ; LASER_ON frames, then it cools for LASER_COOL frames.  Each beam frame the
2241+ D027              ; beam is traced from the muzzle along the current view direction (the round
2242+ D027              ; walk, LASER_RANGE long) to the first building, ground or zombie, killing a
2243+ D027              ; zombie it reaches.  It is kept in laser_rec as a round (state 3) whose
2244+ D027              ; path runs from the muzzle to where the beam stops; draw_bullets clips it
2245+ D027              ; to the view, so it rises from the bottom edge of the screen.
2246+ D027              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2247+ D027              laser_update:

2254+ D034 3A 79 DA             ld a,(las_cool)

2258+ D03B 30 01                jr nc,.cs
2259+ D03D AF                   xor a

2264+ D046 FE 02                cp WPN_LASER

2272+ D056 32 8A 3C             ld (sfx_req),a
2273+ D059 3A 78 DA     .beam:  ld a,(las_on)                   ; this frame's ticks of beam: its
2274+ D05C 4F                   ld c,a                          ; damage
2275+ D05D 3A 50 A8             ld a,(dt)
2276+ D060 B9                   cp c
2277+ D061 38 01                jr c,.pt
2278+ D063 79                   ld a,c                          ; (the rest of it)
2279+ D064 32 6B DA     .pt:    ld (las_t),a

2282+ D069 90                   sub b
2283+ D06A 32 78 DA             ld (las_on),a

2286+ D071 32 79 DA             ld (las_cool),a

2290+ D07E CD 6A C3             call aim_apply

2292+ D084                      ASSERT LASER_DMG == 1
2293+ D084 DD 77 19             ld (ix+B_DMG),a

2295+ D08A DD 7E 00             ld a,(ix+B_STATE)

2297+ D08E C8                   ret z                           ; off the map (can't, inside the wall)

2301+ D094              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
2302+ D094              ; The crash, each frame the VTOL is a wreck (vtol_dead; vtol_wreck, player.asm,
2303+ D094              ; spins it down): fire bursts WRECK_AHEAD in front of the camera.  The first
2304+ D094              ; frame an explosion (WRECK_BOOM, a shake, a bang); falling, WRECK_DEBRIS
2305+ D094              ; every other frame; the frame it is down (dead_down) the impact
2306+ D094              ; (WRECK_IMPACT, the heavy shake, the crash); then WRECK_EMBERS every 4th

3408+ D9C2              ; HL = s -> HL = height of the path there, y0 + s * slope, the drop (or
3409+ D9C2              ; climb) rounded to the nearest unit: truncated, a slow round's (a bomb's,
3410+ D9C2              ; 20 units a frame) lost up to 1 unit a frame, flattening its glide.  s is

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - main menu (8K page PAGE_MAINMENU, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Shown after start-up, after game over, a load error, and quitting from the
   5+ C000              ; pause (menu_go, zpolice.asm, pages it in).  Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256
   6+ C000              ; (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the large font
   7+ C000              ; (26 x 25 characters), over a picture: ZPDATA/MAINMENU.ZPI, read from the
   8+ C000              ; SD card as the menu opens (l320_image; tools/screen_editor.py edits it),
   9+ C000              ; drawn first as the background, the text printed over it with no paper.  Every frame it
  10+ C000              ; advances the random number generator (zrand), so the game doesn't start
  11+ C000              ; from the same seed each time (the wait for a key press varies), then reads
  12+ C000              ; the keys:
  13+ C000              ;   1  New game   -> newGame (zpolice.asm): level 1
  14+ C000              ;   2  Continue   -> the save game (made by save and quit, from the pause:
  15+ C000              ;                 game_pause), its level at its wave (load_save,
  16+ C000              ;                 continue_game, zpolice.asm); NO SAVED GAME if there's none
  17+ C000              ;   9  Redefine keys -> keydef_screen (keydef.asm)
  18+ C000              ; The game start puts the game's Layer 2 back (l2_game_mode).
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              MM_COL          equ 2               ; the options' column
  22+ C000              MM_NOSAVE_ROW   equ 18
  23+ C000

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level complete screen (8K page PAGE_LEVELEND, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;

   8+ C000              ; CONTINUE and the load-out screen (loadout_go).  After the last level, the
   9+ C000              ; game complete screen instead (game_done_go: menu.asm).  Drawn on Layer 2
  10+ C000              ; at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in slot 2) in the

  98+ C090              ; Salvage, at the end of a level: each human saved this level (saved) adds
  99+ C090              ; a salvage point (salvage_points).  Every point total in salvage_tab that

 103+ C090              ; module (fitted at once, its tank full).  After the table's last total,

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - level loading (8K page PAGE_LEVEL, game logic: runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6; it pages the file handler, PAGE_FILE, into slot 7)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Each level is a file, ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPL, naming its city, ZPDATA/CITYnn.ZPC
   6+ C000              ; (both made by gentables.py; the formats are described there).  A city is
   7+ C000              ; played for several levels.  load_level reads both:
   8+ C000              ;   * the level record into level_cur (levels.asm): city name, zombie and
   9+ C000              ;     wave counts, the draw distance, ...;
  10+ C000              ;   * the city into the city bank (page 7, slot 3): city_col at $6000 and
  11+ C000              ;     city_map at $7000, one 8K read;
  12+ C000              ;   * the level's own map changes (x, z, cell code, city_col), for hand-made
  13+ C000              ;     layouts;
  14+ C000              ;   * the city's palette and sky colour into the Layer 2 palette, then the
  15+ C000              ;     level's own palette over it, if it has one (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP);
  16+ C000              ;   * view_r / dot_r from the draw distance (2..VIEW_R tiles).
  17+ C000              ; Loading the map also clears every cell's zombie and human marks.  The
  18+ C000              ; files must be in the ZPDATA folder beside zpolice.nex on the SD card.
  19+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  20+ C000
  21+ C000              ; Level file
  22+ C000              LVF_CITY        equ 5               ; city number
  23+ C000              LVF_REC         equ 6               ; the level record (LV_SIZE bytes)
  24+ C000              LVF_NCHG        equ LVF_REC+LV_SIZE ; number of map changes,
  25+ C000              LVF_CHG         equ LVF_NCHG+1      ; then x, z, cell code, city_col each
  26+ C000              LVF_CHG_MAX     equ 64
  27+ C000              LVF_MAX         equ LVF_CHG+4*LVF_CHG_MAX
  28+ C000              ; City file
  29+ C000              CTF_SKY         equ 14              ; sky colour: RRRGGGBB, low blue bit
  30+ C000              CTF_PAL         equ 32              ; the palette, 256 pairs
  31+ C000              CTF_DATA        equ CTF_PAL+512     ; then city_col, city_map
  32+ C000              ; Level palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPP, optional: tools/levelpal.py)
  33+ C000              LPF_PAL         equ 8               ; the palette, 256 pairs
  34+ C000              LPF_SIZE        equ LPF_PAL+512
  35+ C000              LEVEL_VERSION   equ 2               ; the files' format versions (+4): the
  36+ C000              CITY_VERSION    equ 1               ;   level file's 2 (specials by wave)
  37+ C000              LPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  38+ C000              ; Vision palette file (ZPDATA/LEVELnn.ZPV: tools/visionpal.py)
  39+ C000              VPF_PAL         equ 8               ; 4 palettes (VM_MODES), 256 pairs each
  40+ C000              VPF_SIZE        equ VPF_PAL+4*512
  41+ C000              VPAL_VERSION    equ 1
  42+ C000              LDERR_BADFILE   equ 255             ; error code: not a valid file
  43+ C000
  44+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  45+ C000              ; A = level (1..99): load it.  Carry set on failure, A = the esxDOS error
  46+ C000              ; code or LDERR_BADFILE.  Leaves PAGE_FILE in slot 7.
  47+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  48+ C000              load_level:

 224+ C173              ; K_VISION pressed (main_loop, this page in slot 6): the next vision mode
 225+ C173              ; the VTOL has (vision_owned), or back to normal after the last; its
 226+ C173              ; palette into the Layer 2 palette.  Nothing without the level's vision
 227+ C173              ; palettes, or with no vision mode.

 273+ C1B3              ; HL -> 256 palette pairs (RRRGGGBB, low blue bit): into Layer 2 palette 0

 287+ C1CA              ; The devil hurt (dv_dark, devil.asm): in normal vision, the level's normal

 302+ C1DF ED 91 40 00          nextreg $40,0

 341+ C210 30 01                jr nc,.b

 343+ C213 6F           .b:     ld l,a

 347+ C21A 7D                   ld a,l

 349+ C21D ED 92 44             nextreg $44,a
 350+ C220 E1                   pop hl
 351+ C221 C1                   pop bc
 352+ C222 10 C1                djnz .pl
 353+ C224 C9                   ret

 355+ C225              ; HL -> a file's first bytes, DE -> its 4-byte magic: carry clear if they

 373+ C236              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
 374+ C236              ; At start-up (this page in slot 6, the file handler set up): the figures'

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - load-out screen (8K page PAGE_LOADOUT, runs at $C000 in slot 6)
   3+ C000              ;
   4+ C000              ; Before the first level (newGame) and between levels, after LEVEL COMPLETE
   5+ C000              ; (loadout_go pages it in).  On the
   6+ C000              ; left, the store: every weapon type unlocked (wpn_unlocked) with the number
   7+ C000              ; in store (wpn_stock), even 0 when the only one is fitted.  On the right,
   8+ C000              ; the VTOL's 5 weapon slots: a picture of the VTOL (ZPDATA/VTOL.ZPI, read
   9+ C000              ; from the SD card as the screen opens: l320_image) drawn first, as the
  10+ C000              ; background, with a box and the number at each slot's hardpoint (lo_hp),
  11+ C000              ; and the list of what is fitted in each.  The text is printed over the
  12+ C000              ; picture (no paper); a field that changes gets its piece of the background
  13+ C000              ; back first (l320_bg_save, l320_restore).
  14+ C000              ;   1-5    select a slot (yellow)
  15+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the store list.  The highlighted
  16+ C000              ;          weapon is green if it can be fitted in the selected slot (the
  17+ C000              ;          slot allows it, wpn_fits, and one is in store), red if not; the
  18+ C000              ;          rest of the list is white.
  19+ C000              ;   SPACE  fit the highlighted weapon in the selected slot, if it can be:
  20+ C000              ;          one comes out of the store, with a full load (WCFG_LOAD), and
  21+ C000              ;          whatever was fitted there goes back into the store
  22+ C000              ;   U      unload the selected slot: its weapon back into the store, the
  23+ C000              ;          slot EMPTY (lo_unload)
  24+ C000              ;   0      done: start the level (next_level), only with a weapon in slot 1
  25+ C000              ;          (the centre slot); while it is empty 0: START LEVEL is red
  26+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  27+ C000              ; slot 2), with the keys page in slot 7: the title, help and START LEVEL in
  28+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and lists in the 8x8 one (40
  29+ C000              ; x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  30+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  31+ C000
  32+ C000              LO_TITLE_ROW    equ 1               ; (large font)
  33+ C000              LO_HEAD_ROW     equ 4               ; STORE, SLOTS (8x8)
  34+ C000              LO_ROW0         equ 6               ; first row of the lists (8x8)

  36+ C000              LO_CNT_COL      equ 16              ;   numbers in store

   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - redefine keys screen (8K page PAGE_KEYDEF, runs at $C000 in
   3+ C000              ; slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; From the main menu (option 9, keydef_go pages it in).  Lists every control
   6+ C000              ; (K_ACTIONS of them) with its key (key_defs) and its joystick input
   7+ C000              ; (joy_defs, "-" for none; input.asm).
   8+ C000              ;   Q / A  move the highlight up / down the list (white; highlighted green);
   9+ C000              ;          KD_VIS rows of it show, scrolling to keep the highlight in view
  10+ C000              ;   SPACE  "PRESS A KEY OR JOYSTICK", a second's pause, then the next input
  11+ C000              ;          becomes the highlighted control's key, or its joystick input if
  12+ C000              ;          it is a joystick's, unless another control already uses it: then
  13+ C000              ;          "KEY ALREADY IN USE" (for a second) and no change
  14+ C000              ;   0      every key and joystick input back to its default (key_defaults,
  15+ C000              ;          joy_defaults)
  16+ C000              ;   1      back to the main menu (menu_go), saving the definitions first if
  17+ C000              ;          they changed (kd_save; "KEYS NOT SAVED" for a second if they
  18+ C000              ;          couldn't be)
  19+ C000              ; These keys are fixed (key_code_pressed), whatever the controls are set to.
  20+ C000              ; Drawn on Layer 2 at 320x256 (screen320, text.asm; layer2-320x256.asm in
  21+ C000              ; slot 2), with the input page in slot 7: the title, messages and help in
  22+ C000              ; the large font (26 x 25 grid), the headings and the list in the 8x8 one
  23+ C000              ; (40 x 32 grid: they need the columns).
  24+ C000              ;
  25+ C000              ; The definitions are kept on the SD card as ZPDATA/KEYS.ZPK (beside the level
  26+ C000              ; files): "ZPKY", KF_VERSION, K_ACTIONS, then key_defs and joy_defs (2 bytes
  27+ C000              ; each control).  start loads them (kd_load, with this page in slot 6), if the
  28+ C000              ; file is there and fits this game: else the defaults.
  29+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  30+ C000
  31+ C000              KD_TITLE_ROW    equ 1               ; (large font)
  32+ C000              KD_HEAD_ROW     equ 3               ; the columns' headings (8x8)
  33+ C000              KD_ROW0         equ 4               ; first row of the list (8x8)
  34+ C000              KD_NAME_COL     equ 2               ; control names,
  35+ C000              KD_KEY_COL      equ 18              ; their keys,
  36+ C000              KD_KEY_LEN      equ 7               ;   (key names at most this long)
  37+ C000              KD_JOY_COL      equ 28              ; their joystick inputs
  38+ C000              KD_JOY_LEN      equ 8               ;   (joystick names at most this long)

  40+ C000              KD_MSG_ROW      equ 22              ; messages (large font)
  41+ C000              KD_HELP_ROW     equ 23              ; the keys' help, two lines (large)
  42+ C000              KD_PAUSE        equ 50              ; a second of 50 Hz frames

  44+ C000                      ASSERT (KD_ROW0 + KD_VIS)*8 <= F12_Y0 + KD_MSG_ROW*F12_H  ; (more than
  45+ C000                      ASSERT KD_HEAD_ROW*8 >= F12_Y0 + (KD_TITLE_ROW+1)*F12_H   ; fit: the list
  46+ C000                      ASSERT KD_VIS <= K_ACTIONS  ;   scrolls, kd_top, to keep kd_cur in view)

# file opened: specials.asm
   1+ C000              ;==============================================================================
   2+ C000              ; Z-POLICE - special monsters (8K page PAGE_SPECIAL, game logic: runs at
   3+ C000              ; $C000 in slot 6)
   4+ C000              ;
   5+ C000              ; Special monsters use the zombie records after the zombies' own (NZOMB ..
   6+ C000              ; NMON-1, zombie.asm), so they share the zombies' drawing (zombie_cell,
   7+ C000              ; fig_draw), map blips, cell marks (zflags), weapon hits and zdamage.  The
   8+ C000              ; record's type (+15) says which monster it is.  Each wave's specials come
   9+ C000              ; from the level file (level_cur, LV_WAVE_DATA: up to LV_SPEC_SLOTS types,
  10+ C000              ; SPEC_*, and how many of each), placed by spec_wave as the wave starts;
  11+ C000              ; the level's start is wave 1 (spec_init).  spec_update moves them each
  12+ C000              ; frame, after zombie_update.
  13+ C000              ;
  14+ C000              ; The ghost (ZT_GHOST, special monster id SPEC_GHOST): a stick man under a white
  15+ C000              ; sheet.  It can't attack the base.  It flies at twice the zombies' speed,
  16+ C000              ; at any angle, and up and down between the ground and the VTOL's ceiling
  17+ C000              ; (MAX_Y), over buildings lower than it.
  18+ C000              ;   * Roaming: it flies in a random direction (a random climb or descent
  19+ C000              ;     too) until something makes it turn: a building in the way or the map
  20+ C000              ;     edge (a new random direction at once), or, at its decision check
  21+ C000              ;     every GHOST_DECIDE (30) frames, a human or the VTOL within GHOST_SEE
  22+ C000              ;     (3 tiles) that it can see.
  23+ C000              ;   * Chasing: it flies straight at the nearest one it can see, aiming
  24+ C000              ;     again every GHOST_TRACK (5) frames.  If it loses sight of its target
  25+ C000              ;     (behind a taller building) or the target is gone, it roams again in a
  26+ C000              ;     random direction, back on the 30-frame cycle.
  27+ C000              ;   * Attacking: within ATTACK_R (0.1 tile) of its target on each axis it
  28+ C000              ;     stops and takes GHOST_DMG hit point every GHOST_HIT_FRAMES (10)
  29+ C000              ;     frames: from a human (HUMAN_HP) until it dies, or from the VTOL
  30+ C000              ;     (vtol_hp, VTOL_HP; at 0 it is destroyed and the game ends).  Its map blip is red
  31+ C000              ;     meanwhile (zatk_flags, zblip_red), as an attacking zombie's.  If the
  32+ C000              ;     target moves out of reach it chases it again; once the human is dead
  33+ C000              ;     it roams again.
  34+ C000              ;   * It has GHOST_HP (10) hit points; any weapon can shoot it.  Killed, it
  35+ C000              ;     fades out where it is, white to near black in 4 steps of 3 frames
  36+ C000              ;     (GM_DYING; zdamage starts it, zombie_draw colours it, g_dying ends
  37+ C000              ;     it), and can't be hit meanwhile.
  38+ C000              ; Ghost record fields, besides the zombies' (zombie.asm):
  39+ C000              ;   +11 frames to its next decision check, +16 mode (GM_*), +17 frames to
  40+ C000              ;   its next blow, +18 hit points, +21,+22 height of its feet, +23,+24 and
  41+ C000              ;   +25,+26 velocity x, z (signed 8.8 units a frame), +27,+28 the x and z
  42+ C000              ;   position fractions, +29 climb (signed units a frame), +30 target
  43+ C000              ;   (TG_NONE, TG_VTOL, or a human's index).
  44+ C000              ;==============================================================================
  45+ C000
  46+ C000              GHOST_HP        equ 10              ; hit points
  47+ C000              GHOST_DECIDE    equ 30              ; frames between decisions while roaming
  48+ C000              GHOST_TRACK     equ 5               ; and while chasing
  49+ C000              GHOST_SEE       equ 3*TILE_UNITS    ; it spots humans / the VTOL this near
  50+ C000              GHOST_HIT_FRAMES equ 10             ; frames between blows
  51+ C000              GHOST_DMG       equ 1               ; hit points a blow
  52+ C000              GHOST_CLIMB     equ 1               ; units a frame up or down
  53+ C000              GHOST_AIM_MIN   equ 80              ; (aiming: nearer counts as this far)
  54+ C000              GM_ROAM         equ 0               ; modes (+16)
  55+ C000              GM_CHASE        equ 1
  56+ C000              GM_ATTACK       equ 2
  57+ C000              GM_DYING        equ 3               ; killed: fading out (+17 frames left)
  58+ C000              GHOST_FADE_FRAMES equ 12            ; the fade: 4 steps of 3 frames
  59+ C000              TG_NONE         equ $FF             ; targets (+30)
  60+ C000              TG_VTOL         equ $FE
  61+ C000              TG_BASE         equ $C0             ; + a base tile's index (base_hp, 0..24)
  62+ C000              ; The banshee (ZT_BANSHEE, id SPEC_BANSHEE): a ghost that flies twice as
  63+ C000              ; fast, reaches BANSHEE_R (0.5 tile), does BANSHEE_DMG a blow and also
  64+ C000              ; attacks the base (the terrace and pad tiles).
  65+ C000              ; The ghoul (ZT_GHOUL, id SPEC_GHOUL, zombie.asm): a half-height zombie
  66+ C000              ; walking at five times the zombies' speed.  It is placed here (spec_wave)
  67+ C000              ; but moved, drawn and hit as a zombie.
  68+ C000              ; The lich (ZT_LICH, id SPEC_LICH): a city's boss, in the last wave of its
  69+ C000              ; last level (the level files).  Placed here (lich_init); walks as a zombie
  70+ C000              ; at 4 times the speed, drawn at LICH_H; shoots fireballs at the VTOL
  71+ C000              ; (lich_update, weapons.asm).  Each city's is harder: LICH_HP + LICH_HP_STEP
  72+ C000              ; hit points a city before it, and a shot every LICH_RATE frames,
  73+ C000              ; LICH_RATE_STEP fewer a city before it, at least LICH_RATE_MIN.  Its
  74+ C000              ; record: +18 and +23 (LICH_HP_HI) its hit points, 16 bits; +24 (LICH_WAIT)
  75+ C000              ; frames to its next shot; +25 (LICH_FRAMES) frames between.
  76+ C000              ; The devil (ZT_DEVIL, id SPEC_DEVIL): the final boss (devil.asm).
  77+ C000              ; (Which waves have which is the level files' business: gentables.py.)
  78+ C000              BANSHEE_HP      equ 8
  79+ C000              BANSHEE_DMG     equ 5
  80+ C000              BANSHEE_R       equ TILE_UNITS/2
  81+ C000              BASE_TILES      equ (2*TERRACE_R+1)*(2*TERRACE_R+1)
  82+ C000              LICH_HP         equ 25              ; the first city's
  83+ C000              LICH_HP_STEP    equ 5               ; more a city
  84+ C000              LICH_RATE       equ 150             ; the first city's frames between shots
  85+ C000              LICH_RATE_STEP  equ 5               ; fewer a city
  86+ C000              LICH_RATE_MIN   equ 10
  87+ C000
  88+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  89+ C000              ; A level's start: every special record inactive, then wave 1's specials
  90+ C000              ; (the level's start is wave 1, as any other: spec_wave)
  91+ C000              ;------------------------------------------------------------------------------
  92+ C000              spec_init:

  94+ C004 06 08                ld b,NSPEC
  95+ C006 0E 28                ld c,NZOMB                      ; record index

   2++C7D3              ; Z-POLICE - the final boss: the devil (in the special monsters' page,
   3++C7D3              ; PAGE_SPECIAL, at $C000 in slot 6: specials.asm includes it)
   4++C7D3              ;
   5++C7D3              ; Quatermass's horned Martian, ten building levels tall (DEVIL_H, 46 m) and a
   6++C7D3              ; whole square wide, in the last wave of the last level (the level files:
   7++C7D3              ; SPEC_DEVIL, alone).  It rises at the entrance to hell (HELL_X, HELL_Z: a
   8++C7D3              ; circle of road the level's map changes make) or, if that isn't road, on a
   9++C7D3              ; street at random (zplace).  A special monster record (zombie.asm), type
  10++C7D3              ; ZT_DEVIL; drawn by devil_draw (city2.asm) from its own graphics, which go
  11++C7D3              ; over the other monsters' pages when its wave starts (wave_prepare,
  12++C7D3              ; devil_load: only the zombies and humans are drawn with it).
  13++C7D3              ;   * It walks the streets to the landing pad, half a tile a step
  14++C7D3              ;     (DV_STEP_FR frames each: moving for DV_MOVE_FR, then planted), every
  15++C7D3              ;     footfall shaking the view.  At a cell's middle it takes the way that
  16++C7D3              ;     brings it nearest the pad (not back the way it came unless it must);
  17++C7D3              ;     a terrace or pad tile it steps onto is crushed (base_damage: the pad,
  18++C7D3              ;     game over).
  19++C7D3              ;   * Its eyes charge, black to blue, wherever the VTOL is, for
  20++C7D3              ;     DV_CHARGE_T interrupts (10 s; a rising whine for the last DV_HUM_T,
  21++C7D3              ;     3 s: SFX_CHARGE), then it fires lightning (a crackling zap and
  22++C7D3              ;     thunder: SFX_BOLT): straight at the
  23++C7D3              ;     VTOL, instantly, through anything in the way.  A building the bolt
  24++C7D3              ;     passes below the roof of comes down (dv_topple: DV_PARTS particles,
  25++C7D3              ;     falling 1 m every 2 frames to RUBBLE_H; the humans on it killed; the
  26++C7D3              ;     map in memory only).  The VTOL takes BOLT_DMG, spins 15-90 degrees
  27++C7D3              ;     either way (spin_rate, spin_t: player.asm), is pitched full up or
  28++C7D3              ;     down, and is braked to a stop as the air brake does (bolt_brake).
  29++C7D3              ;     Then DV_REST_T interrupts (2 s) before it charges again.
  30++C7D3              ;   * DEVIL_HP hit points (16 bits, as a lich's: +18 and LICH_HP_HI); its
  31++C7D3              ;     hit box DEVIL_HIT_R either side, DEVIL_H tall (weapons.asm).  Killed,
  32++C7D3              ;     it sinks into the ground over DV_DIE_FR frames in fire, then it's gone.
  33++C7D3              ; Its record, besides the zombies' fields: +4 heading (0 +z, 1 +x, 2 -z,
  34++C7D3              ; 3 -x), +5 its legs' frame, +7 1: stuck (nowhere to go), +11 the frame in
  35++C7D3              ; its step, +16 mode (0 walking, GM_DYING), +17 frames left sinking,
  36++C7D3              ; +21,+22 its feet (below the ground as it sinks), DV_EYES (0 resting,
  37++C7D3              ; 1 charging) and DV_T0 (game_now when that began).
  38++C7D3              ;==============================================================================
  39++C7D3

  53++C7D3              ; a new one every STORM_GAP..STORM_GAP+3 ticks at first, slowing as it
  54++C7D3              ; goes (+1 tick each 16 ticks of it: about 35 at the end), each drawn
